note.en: Hours of Neighbors Café in the lobby; lobby hours not listed.
note.zh: 这是大堂 Neighbors Café 的营业时间，大堂本身没写。

note.en: Hotel FAQ says Wi-Fi is complimentary for guests; non-guest access not stated.
note.zh: 官网 FAQ 说住客免费 Wi-Fi，没说非住客能不能用。

note.en: Described as calm and zen; no direct noise reports.
note.zh: 都形容很安静很 zen，但没人具体说噪音。

note.en: A blog calls the lobby inviting for hours on a laptop; the hotel only says its lounge is open to guests for work.
note.zh: 有博客说大堂适合抱着电脑待几个小时，但酒店官方只说住客可以在 lounge 办公。

blurb.en: Plant-filled, high-ceilinged lobby by Brooklyn Bridge Park with couches and big windows; grab coffee at Neighbors Café to settle in.
blurb.zh: Brooklyn Bridge Park 边上的酒店大堂，层高很高、全是绿植，有沙发和大窗。在 Neighbors Café 买杯咖啡就能坐下来。

en: Wi-Fi is officially for guests only; bring a hotspot.
Mostly couches, not desks.
Buy something at Neighbors Café (7am–5pm).
zh: 官方说 Wi-Fi 是给住客的，最好自带热点。
基本是沙发，不是桌子。
记得在 Neighbors Café 消费一下（早7点到下午5点）。

note.en: Hours for the second-floor Library, per a 2026 guide; not listed on the hotel site.
note.zh: 这是二楼Library的开放时间，来自2026年的攻略，酒店官网没写。

note.en: The second-floor Library is described as very quiet and rarely packed.
note.zh: 二楼的Library很安静，基本不会人满。

note.en: The hotel markets the Library as a co-working space.
note.zh: 酒店官方把Library定位成共享办公空间。

blurb.en: Hidden second-floor Library at a SoHo hotel, pitched as an office away from the office: quiet, strong Wi-Fi, coffee to cocktails, open 7am to 11pm.
blurb.zh: SoHo酒店二楼藏着的Library，官方就把它当共享办公空间。很安静，网速好，从咖啡到鸡尾酒都有，早7点开到晚11点。

en: It's on the second floor and easy to miss; ask the front desk.
Plan to order something; it's unclear whether non-guests can sit without buying.
zh: 在二楼，很容易错过，可以问前台怎么走。
最好点点东西，不确定非住客不消费能不能坐。

note.en: NYPL's branch page could not be read; check nypl.org before going.
note.zh: NYPL官网页面打不开，去之前请上nypl.org查营业时间。

note.en: NYC 311 says all public library locations have free Wi-Fi during open hours; a June 2026 guide says the 'NYPL' network needs no password. Speed not tested.
note.zh: NYC 311官网说所有公共图书馆开放时间都有免费Wi-Fi；2026年6月的攻略说连「NYPL」就行，不用密码。网速没人实测。

note.en: New bathrooms were part of the 2024 renovation.
note.zh: 2024年翻修时新装了洗手间。

blurb.en: Landmarked 1904 branch that reopened in late 2024 after a $34M renovation, adding an elevator, a teen center, new bathrooms and better heating and cooling.
blurb.zh: 1904年的地标级老图书馆，2024年底花了3400万翻修后重新开放，新加了电梯、青少年中心和新洗手间，冷暖气也升级了。

en: Hours, outlets and seating are unverified; NYPL's site blocked our check.
zh: 开放时间、插座和座位都还没核实，NYPL官网查不到。

note.en: APOPS lists these hours as of March 2023, 'probably accurate'.
note.zh: APOPS上的时间是2023年3月更新的，大概率准确，但比较旧。

note.en: Visitors in 2024–25 report wifi; speed is unknown.
note.zh: 2024–25年有访客说有wifi，网速不清楚。

note.en: Outlets exist but are limited.
note.zh: 有插座，但不多。

note.en: 24 movable tables and 120 chairs.
note.zh: 24张可移动桌子、120把椅子。

note.en: Visitors call it calm, but sound installations have been reported.
note.zh: 访客说很安静，但也有人提到有声音装置作品在放声音。

note.en: Movable tables and chairs can be pulled together.
note.zh: 桌椅都能搬，拼一桌没问题。

note.en: Two required public restrooms, though one past report says they were locked.
note.zh: 按规定有两个公共洗手间，不过以前有人反映被锁了。

blurb.en: A big, sunny indoor atrium by the East River: 24 tables, 120 movable chairs, restrooms and a café kiosk, all free. Often called the best indoor public space downtown.
blurb.zh: 东河边的大型室内中庭，阳光很好。24张桌子、120把椅子随便坐，有洗手间和咖啡小亭，全部免费。号称下城最好的室内公共空间。

en: Few outlets, so arrive charged.
Tables aren't very comfortable for a long day.
Some visitors report a smoke smell on weekday evenings.
zh: 插座很少，记得先充满电。
桌椅坐久了不太舒服。
有人说工作日晚上会有烟味。

note.en: Required public hours are 7am–11pm; may close from 3pm (weekdays) or 5pm (weekends) for up to 12 posted events a year. Sources date from 2022–2023.
note.zh: 规定开放时间每天早7点到晚11点；每年最多12次活动可能提前关（工作日下午3点后、周末5点后），会提前贴告示。来源是2022–2023年的。

note.en: Only source is an undated event-venue listing that says public Wi-Fi is available; speed unknown.
note.zh: 只有一个没写日期的活动场地页面说有公共Wi-Fi，网速未知。

note.en: Required: 226 movable chairs, 4 benches and 104 tables (238 seats).
note.zh: 按规定要有226把可移动椅子、4张长凳、104张桌子，共238个座位。

note.en: Inferred from movable chairs and many tables; no source on group use.
note.zh: 根据椅子能随便挪、桌子多推断的，没有专门说多人用的来源。

note.en: Two public restrooms, gender-inclusive per the 2022 opening coverage.
note.zh: 有两个公共洗手间，2022年开放时的报道说是不分性别的。

blurb.en: Public garden under a big glass canopy, with hundreds of movable chairs, tables, public restrooms and coffee kiosks. Free, no purchase needed.
blurb.zh: 大玻璃顶下的公共花园，几百把可挪动的椅子和桌子，有公共洗手间和咖啡摊。免费，不用消费。

en: Semi-outdoor under a canopy, so it can be cold in winter.
Wi-Fi is mentioned only by an events listing and outlets are unconfirmed; bring a charged laptop.
Can close early for posted private events.
zh: 玻璃顶下半户外，冬天可能会冷。
Wi-Fi只有活动场地页面提过，插座没确认，电脑记得充满电。
偶尔有私人活动会提前关门，会提前贴通知。

note.en: Legally required public hours per APOPS (data as of Mar 2023); up to 12 event closures a year, posted a week ahead.
note.zh: APOPS记录的法定开放时间（2023年3月数据）；每年最多有12次活动包场，会提前一周贴告示。

note.en: Free wifi mentioned in a 2021 article; quality not reported and not reconfirmed.
note.zh: 2021年的文章说有免费Wi-Fi，网速不详，近期没确认。

note.en: Required: 110 movable chairs and 32 movable tables.
note.zh: 按规定要有110把可移动椅子和32张可移动桌子。

note.en: Chairs are movable, but a 2024 visitor reported security stopping them from moving a table.
note.zh: 椅子可以挪，但2024年有人反映保安不让挪桌子。

note.en: Restrooms are not a required amenity here; none confirmed.
note.zh: 厕所不在规定配套里，没查到有公共厕所。

blurb.en: Glass-roofed bamboo atrium off Madison and 57th: free, public, with lots of movable tables and chairs and a food kiosk. A calm Midtown escape.
blurb.zh: Madison和57街路口的玻璃竹子中庭，免费对公众开放，可移动桌椅很多，还有小吃亭。中城难得的清静角落。

en: Can close for private events (from 3pm weekdays, 5pm weekends).
Security may stop you rearranging tables.
No confirmed public restroom.
zh: 偶尔有包场活动（工作日下午3点、周末5点后可能关）。
保安可能不让你挪桌子。
没查到公共厕所。

note.en: 787's site says 7am–7pm daily; Half Half Travel (Sept 2026) says it closes at 6pm.
note.zh: 787 官网写每天7点到7点，Half Half Travel（2026年9月）说下午6点关。

note.en: Described as reliable.
note.zh: 都说网络稳定。

note.en: Listed as a laptop-friendly alternative to West Village cafes that ban laptops.
note.zh: 被列为西村少有的能开电脑的咖啡馆。

blurb.en: Exposed-brick 787 near Christopher St with reliable Wi-Fi and lots of outlets: one of the few laptop-friendly picks in the West Village.
blurb.zh: Christopher St 附近的 787，红砖墙，网稳插座多，是西村少有欢迎开电脑的咖啡馆。

en: Closing time unclear (6pm vs 7pm); don't plan an evening session.
Address shows as 204 or 208 W 10th St depending on the source.
zh: 关门时间说法不一（6点还是7点），别指望晚上去。
地址有的写 204 有的写 208 W 10th St。

note.en: Required public hours per APOPS (data as of 2023); Sunday/holidays 11am–7pm. A 2017 visitor was asked to leave at 8pm.
note.zh: APOPS 记录的法定开放时间（2023 年数据），周日和节假日 11am–7pm。2017 年有人反映晚上 8 点就被请出去。

note.en: Required ~67 tables and 252 chairs across three levels, plus café seating.
note.zh: 三层合计要求约 67 张桌子、252 把椅子，另有咖啡座。

note.en: Required tables average about four chairs each.
note.zh: 规定的桌子平均每张约 4 把椅子。

note.en: Two public restrooms on the concourse; a guard opens them and ID was requested in 2017.
note.zh: 地下层有两个公共厕所，要保安开门，2017 年有人说还要登记证件。

blurb.en: Three-level public atrium at E 52nd St with dozens of tables, food stalls and restrooms. Free, open late Mon–Sat, and big enough to spread out with a group.
blurb.zh: 52 街的三层室内公共空间，几十张桌子，有吃的有厕所。免费，周一到周六开到很晚，几个人一起来也坐得下。

en: Shorter Sunday hours (11am–7pm).
Restrooms are guard-controlled; ID was requested in past reports.
A 2025 visitor reported weekday lunchtime piano performances on the lower level.
No Wi-Fi info found; plan on your own hotspot.
zh: 周日只开 11am–7pm。
厕所要保安开门，以前有人说要登记证件。
2025 年有人说工作日午饭时间地下层有钢琴演奏。
没查到有没有 Wi-Fi，最好自带热点。

note.en: OpenStreetMap: community-mapped opening hours
note.zh: OpenStreetMap：社区维护的营业时间

note.en: Described as fast in a 2026-updated guide.
note.zh: 2026年更新的攻略说网速很快。

note.en: Little chatter, but music is playing.
note.zh: 聊天的人不多，比较安静，不过有放音乐。

note.en: Source only describes weekdays as laptop-friendly; weekend policy not found.
note.zh: 攻略只说工作日适合开电脑，周末是否欢迎没找到说法。

note.en: On weekdays three tables are pushed together into a shared work desk.
note.zh: 工作日会把三张桌子拼成一张长桌，小组一起坐没问题。

blurb.en: Indie Atlantic Ave coffee bar where weekday regulars push three tables into a shared work desk; Wi-Fi is fast and the room stays low-chatter.
blurb.zh: Atlantic Ave上的独立咖啡店，工作日大家会把三张桌子拼成长桌一起办公。网速快，没什么人大声聊天，挺适合专心干活。

en: Hours not confirmed; check before you go.
Laptop-friendliness is only documented for weekdays.
No source on outlets; arrive charged.
zh: 营业时间没查到官方版本，去之前先确认一下。
只确认过工作日适合开电脑，周末情况不明。
插座情况不明，最好充满电再去。

note.en: Free Wi-Fi per a July 2024 article; speed not reported.
note.zh: 2024年7月的文章说有免费wifi，网速未知。

note.en: "Plenty of outlets" per a July 2024 article.
note.zh: 2024年7月的文章说插座很多。

note.en: Main room, communal tables, a skylit garden room, and a long work desk.
note.zh: 大厅、公共长桌、带天窗的花园区，还有一张长工作台。

note.en: Cozy by day; turns into a buzzy lounge with music and cocktails at night.
note.zh: 白天挺舒服，晚上变成lounge，有音乐和鸡尾酒，会比较吵。

note.en: Large communal table and sofa clusters around coffee tables.
note.zh: 有大长桌，还有围着茶几的沙发区，几个人一起坐没问题。

blurb.en: Boerum Hill hotel lobby with communal tables, a skylit garden room and a long work desk. Free Wi-Fi and lots of outlets. Grab a coffee at the bar. It turns into a lounge at night.
blurb.zh: Boerum Hill的酒店大堂，有公共长桌、带天窗的花园区和长工作台。免费wifi，插座多，建议在吧台买杯咖啡。晚上会变成lounge。

en: Becomes a bar/lounge at night with music, so it's not for evening focus or calls.
No source says purchase is required, but buying a coffee is the courteous move.
zh: 晚上变成酒吧lounge，有音乐，不适合专注或打电话。
没说必须消费，但买杯咖啡比较礼貌。

note.en: Lobby bar 7am–midnight; Stumptown Mon–Fri 7am–3pm, Sat–Sun 8am–4pm.
note.zh: 大堂酒吧早7点到午夜；Stumptown 工作日7点到3点，周末8点到4点。

note.en: Generally works; a 2023 review called it occasionally a gamble.
note.zh: 大部分时候能用，2023年有测评说偶尔不稳。

note.en: A few under the communal table, not all working (2023).
note.zh: 长桌下面有几个插座，不是每个都能用（2023年）。

note.en: 18-foot communal table (2019 article).
note.zh: 有张18英尺的大长桌（2019年的文章）。

note.en: Single-person restrooms near the back bar (2023).
note.zh: 后面吧台附近有几个单人洗手间（2023年）。

blurb.en: NYC's classic laptop lobby: long communal table, couches and Stumptown up front. Buzzy, dim and loud with music; outlets are hit or miss.
blurb.zh: 纽约最经典的开电脑大堂：大长桌、沙发，门口就是 Stumptown。氛围热闹、灯光偏暗、音乐有点大，插座要碰运气。

en: Loud music and high ceilings: not for focus or calls.
Outlets are scarce and some don't work.
Stumptown closes 3pm weekdays; buy a drink to stay.
zh: 音乐大、层高高，回声多，不适合专注和打电话。
插座少，还有坏的。
Stumptown 工作日3点就关，记得点杯喝的。

note.en: Described as good/free; a 2023 review said it works well. No recent speed test.
note.zh: 都说wifi不错，2023年有人实测好用，但没有最新测速。

note.en: A 2023 review counted at least six outlets.
note.zh: 2023年有人数过，至少6个插座。

note.en: About eight two-tops and a couch inside (2023 count), plus a few sidewalk tables; arrive early.
note.zh: 室内大概8张两人桌加一个沙发（2023年数据），门口还有几张户外桌，最好早点去占位。

note.en: Mostly two-person tables (2023 review).
note.zh: 基本都是两人桌（2023年的点评）。

note.en: A 2026 guide says there's no bathroom; a 2023 reviewer wasn't sure one existed.
note.zh: 2026年的攻略说没有厕所，2023年的点评也没找到。

busyTimes.en: Crowded on rainy days; arrive early for a seat.
busyTimes.zh: 下雨天人特别多，想要位子得早点去。

blurb.en: Small, calm Village cafe with decent Wi-Fi and outlets, popular with students. Seats are mostly two-tops, so come early, and plan your bathroom breaks elsewhere.
blurb.zh: Village一家小而安静的咖啡店，wifi和插座都还行，学生很多。基本是两人小桌，建议早点去，而且店里没厕所。

en: No restroom for customers.
Fills up fast, especially on rainy days.
zh: 店里没有厕所。
位子少，下雨天尤其爆满。

note.en: These are the lobby Bodega's barista hours (official site). Grab-and-go snacks are sold 24/7, but lobby access for non-guests outside these hours is unconfirmed.
note.zh: 这是大堂 Bodega 的咖啡吧营业时间（官网）。零食饮料24小时都能买，但这个时间以外非住客能不能坐大堂没确认。

note.en: A 2019 guide mentions fast fiber Wi-Fi; not reconfirmed.
note.zh: 2019年的指南说是高速光纤Wi-Fi，之后没再确认。

note.en: A 2019 guide says the second-floor library and public spaces are open to all; not reconfirmed.
note.zh: 2019年的指南说二楼图书室和公共区对所有人开放，之后没再确认。

blurb.en: NoMad hotel whose public spaces, including a second-floor library, have been open to non-guests. The on-site Bodega covers coffee and snacks.
blurb.zh: NoMad 的酒店，公共区域（包括二楼图书室）一直对非住客开放，楼里的 Bodega 能买咖啡和零食。

en: Work-space details are from 2019; check before planning a full day.
The lobby Bodega makes coffee only 7am–2pm.
zh: 办公相关信息来自2019年，想待一整天之前先确认。
大堂 Bodega 现做咖啡只到下午2点（早上7点开）。

note.en: Lobby and library lounge reported open 24 hours (2019 Time Out; undated Blacklane).
note.zh: 大堂和图书角据说 24 小时开放（2019 年 Time Out 及无日期的 Blacklane 文章）。

note.en: Described as fast fiber Wi-Fi in older articles.
note.zh: 旧文章说是光纤 Wi-Fi，速度快。

note.en: Hidden outlets in the library lounge past the lobby.
note.zh: 大堂后面的图书角有隐藏插座。

note.en: A 10-seat table in the library lounge.
note.zh: 图书角有一张 10 人大桌。

blurb.en: Hudson Square hotel whose lobby library lounge has hidden outlets and a 10-seat table, with a 24/7 grab-and-go bodega. Sources are older, so treat as a backup.
blurb.zh: Hudson Square 的酒店，大堂后面的图书角有隐藏插座和 10 人大桌，旁边 bodega 24 小时营业。资料偏旧，当备选。

en: Work-friendly details come from 2019-era coverage; recent policy for non-guests is unconfirmed.
zh: 办公相关信息主要来自 2019 年左右的报道，现在对非住客是否开放没确认。

note.en: Posted on Oren's own locations page (Oct 2026): Mon–Sun 8am–3pm.
note.zh: Oren's官网门店页（2026年10月）写的是每天早8点到下午3点。

note.en: One 8-stool high-top, two window two-tops; the rest is couches and armchairs.
note.zh: 一张8人高脚长桌，窗边两张双人桌，其余都是沙发和扶手椅。

note.en: The 8-stool high-top fits a small group.
note.zh: 那张8座高脚桌够一小群人一起坐。

busyTimes.en: Rarely so crowded that you can't get a seat.

blurb.en: Low-key cafe in the AVA DoBro building. It's rarely packed and stays fairly calm, with an 8-stool high-top that suits a small group, though most of the seating is couches.
blurb.zh: 藏在AVA DoBro楼下的小咖啡店，很少爆满，环境比较安静。有一张8人高脚长桌，适合小组一起干活，不过大部分座位是沙发。

en: Few real table surfaces: mostly couches and armchairs.
Wi-Fi and outlets are unconfirmed.
Closes at 3pm every day.
zh: 能放电脑的桌子不多，大多是沙发和扶手椅。
Wi-Fi和插座都还没确认。
每天下午3点就关门了。

note.en: From B&N's own store page (seen as a search snippet; the page body didn't render for us). Time Out and Artbook list longer hours (to 10pm daily), likely outdated.
note.zh: 来自B&N官网门店页（搜索摘要里看到的，页面本身没加载出来）。Time Out等网站写每天开到晚上10点，可能是旧信息。

note.en: Free Wi-Fi reported; speed not measured.
note.zh: 有免费Wi-Fi，网速没人测过。

note.en: Outlets along the walls; grab a wall seat.
note.zh: 插座在墙边，要抢靠墙的位置。

note.en: Huge supply of seating on the third floor.
note.zh: 三楼座位超多。

note.en: A Mar 2025 student guide says tables are open to everyone with no purchase needed; no store policy found.
note.zh: 2025年3月的学生攻略说桌子对所有人开放、不用消费；没找到店里的官方规定。

note.en: Gigantic tables suit big projects; group size not stated.
note.zh: 桌子特别大，适合摊开做项目，具体几人没说。

blurb.en: Third-floor cafe in the Union Square Barnes & Noble with huge tables, lots of seats and free Wi-Fi. No purchase needed; outlets are along the walls, so grab a wall seat.
blurb.zh: Union Square的Barnes & Noble三楼咖啡区，桌子超大、座位多、有免费Wi-Fi，不消费也能坐。插座在墙边，先抢靠墙位。

en: Outlets only along the walls.
Closes at 9pm Sun–Thu (10pm Fri–Sat); cafe hours may differ.
zh: 插座只在墙边。
周日到周四晚上9点关门（周五六10点），咖啡区营业时间可能不一样。

note.en: Free library Wi-Fi in every branch; speed not verified.
note.zh: 全馆免费Wi-Fi，网速还没实测。

blurb.en: Brooklyn's oldest library branch on Franklin Ave, reopened in April 2025 after a four-year renovation with new windows, lighting and heating and cooling. Free, with bookable meeting rooms.
blurb.zh: 布鲁克林最老的图书馆分馆，在Franklin Ave。翻修了四年，2025年4月重新开放，换了新窗户、灯光和冷暖空调。免费，会议室可以预约。

en: Opens at 1pm on Tuesdays and Sundays
Meeting rooms need a BPL card and must be booked ahead (2-hour max online)
zh: 周二和周日下午1点才开门
会议室要BPL借书卡预约，网上最多订2小时

note.en: Only an old (2021) listing of hours found; check current hours.
note.zh: 只找到2021年的营业时间，去之前再确认。

note.en: A 2024 guide says there are a lot of plugs and every window booth has its own outlet; not reconfirmed since.
note.zh: 2024年的指南说插座很多，窗边每个卡座都有，之后没人再确认过。

note.en: Described as spacious with lots of seating (2024 and 2026 guides).
note.zh: 2024和2026的指南都说空间大、座位多。

note.en: Featured in a 2026 laptop-friendly cafe guide; no written policy found.
note.zh: 被2026年的「适合开电脑咖啡馆」指南收录，但没找到明文规定。

blurb.en: Roomy Italian all-day cafe near McCarren Park with plenty of seats and window booths that have their own outlets. Strong pastries for a long session.
blurb.zh: McCarren Park 附近的意式全天咖啡馆，空间大座位多，窗边卡座自带插座。意式甜点也很能打，适合待久一点。

en: Wi-Fi quality unconfirmed.
Current hours not confirmed.
zh: 网速没查到，不一定稳。
营业时间没确认，出发前先查。

note.en: OpenStreetMap: Wi-Fi available; speed not recorded
note.zh: OpenStreetMap：有 Wi-Fi，网速未记录

note.en: 2024 sources describe a front bar plus a back lounge with couches and cocktail tables.
note.zh: 2024年的文章说前面是吧台，后面是沙发和小圆桌的休息区。

note.en: Laptops only 10am–5pm; after 5pm it's laptop-free.
note.zh: 只有上午10点到下午5点能开电脑，5点后全面禁电脑。

blurb.en: SoHo bookstore-cafe lined with thousands of books that turns into a wine bar at night. Laptops are welcome only from 10am to 5pm.
blurb.zh: SoHo的书店咖啡馆，满墙都是书，晚上变成酒吧。只有早10点到下午5点可以开电脑。

en: Laptops are banned after 5pm.
Walk-ins only before 4pm; after 5pm seats go to dinner guests and reservations.
zh: 下午5点以后禁止开电脑。
4点前可以直接进；5点后座位优先给晚餐和订位的客人。

note.en: Birdee's own site says open daily 8am–4pm, matching Time Out and Secret NYC opening coverage.
note.zh: Birdee官网写每天早8点到下午4点营业，和开业时Time Out、Secret NYC的报道一致。

note.en: Only evidence: it's listed in The Infatuation's 'coffee shops with wifi for getting work done' guide (Sep 2026). The entry itself doesn't mention Wi-Fi or speed.
note.zh: 唯一线索是它上了The Infatuation 2026年9月的「有wifi、适合办公的咖啡馆」榜单，但条目里没具体提wifi和网速。

note.en: Both Infatuation pieces call it large, with plenty of space to work.
note.zh: Infatuation两篇都说空间很大，办公位置充足。

note.en: Tagged 'Getting Work Done' by The Infatuation.
note.zh: Infatuation把它归到“适合干活”的类别。

blurb.en: Big, bright all-day cafe inside The Refinery at Domino on the Williamsburg waterfront. Lots of room to work, plus laminated pastries from an Eleven Madison Park alum.
blurb.zh: 在Williamsburg海边Domino Refinery大楼里的全天咖啡店，空间超大，很好找位置干活。可颂类酥皮点心是前Eleven Madison Park甜点师做的。

en: Wi-Fi only implied by a 'cafes with wifi' list, and outlets are unconfirmed.
Pricey ($$$$ per The Infatuation), and popular pastries sell out early.
Feels a bit corporate since it sits in an office building.
Closes at 4pm daily.
zh: wifi只是从「有wifi的咖啡馆」榜单推断的，插座也没确认。
价格偏贵（Infatuation标的是$$$$），热门酥皮点心早早就卖光。
在写字楼里，氛围有点偏商务。
每天下午4点关门。

note.en: From a 2017 Time Out listing; not confirmed recently.
note.zh: 来自2017年的Time Out，最近没核实过。

note.en: Sources disagree: WFHishNYC (Mar 2025) says outlets are abundant; The Working Line (Jun 2025) says they are limited. Charge up first.
note.zh: 说法不一：WFHishNYC（2025年3月）说插座很多，The Working Line（2025年6月）说插座有限。建议先充好电。

note.en: About five 2-tops, one 4-top, three bar stools and six couches.
note.zh: 大概5张两人桌、1张四人桌、3个吧台位和6张沙发。

note.en: Only one table seats four; the couches may fit more but not reliably.
note.zh: 只有一张四人桌，沙发区或许能多坐几个人，但不一定有位。

blurb.en: Dim, cozy LES coffee shop with leather couches, board games and printers. Wifi is reliable and the vibe is chill, a favorite with remote workers.
blurb.zh: 下东区的复古小咖啡馆，光线偏暗，有皮沙发、桌游，还能打印。网络稳定，氛围很chill，远程办公的人很爱来。

en: Mostly couches and 2-tops; only one table for four.
Outlet reports conflict, so come charged.
One customer bathroom.
zh: 大多是沙发和两人桌，四人桌只有一张。
插座说法不一，最好带满电来。
只有一个厕所，仅限顾客。

note.en: Weekday 8am–midnight per a 2025 guide; weekend 9am start from a 2022 report. Another 2026 page says it opens at 9am daily.
note.zh: 2025年的攻略写工作日8点到午夜；周末9点开门是2022年的信息；另一个2026年的页面说每天9点开门。

note.en: Sources conflict: Half Half (Sep 2026) says there is no Wi-Fi and it shouldn't be advertised that way; a Jun 2025 guide said free Wi-Fi. Plan to tether.
note.zh: 说法打架：Half Half（2026年9月）明确说没有Wi-Fi，还特意提醒别被误导；2025年6月的攻略说有免费Wi-Fi。建议自带热点。

note.en: Sources conflict: Half Half (Sep 2026) says there's nowhere to charge; a Jun 2025 guide mentioned outlets. Come fully charged.
note.zh: 说法不一：Half Half（2026年9月）说没地方充电，2025年6月的攻略说有插座。还是充满电再去。

note.en: A 2022 report says it's crowded at all hours; mostly armchairs.
note.zh: 2022年的报道说这里什么时候都挺挤，座位以扶手椅为主。

note.en: Laptops must go away in the evening (7pm per two sources, 6pm per Half Half, Sep 2026). A 2022 report also said no laptops on weekends; recent guides don't mention a weekend ban.
note.zh: 晚上要收电脑（两个来源说7点，Half Half 2026年9月说6点）。2022年的报道还说周末不让开电脑，最近的攻略都没提周末禁电脑。

blurb.en: Bookstore cafe by day, bar by night, with armchairs to read in. Laptops are a daytime thing only, seats go fast, and Wi-Fi and outlets are disputed, so come charged.
blurb.zh: 白天是书店咖啡馆，晚上变酒吧，扶手椅很适合窝着看书。只有白天能开电脑，座位很抢手；Wi-Fi和插座说法不一，记得充满电再去。

en: Laptops away by 6–7pm, when it turns into a bar with events.
Reportedly no laptops on weekends (2022 report; unconfirmed since).
Wi-Fi and outlets are disputed; the latest report says neither. Tether and come charged.
Often crowded.
zh: 晚上6-7点之后要收电脑，变成酒吧办活动。
2022年有报道说周末不让开电脑（之后没再确认）。
Wi-Fi和插座说法不一，最新的报道说都没有，自带热点、充满电再去。
人经常很多。

note.en: Hotel site doesn't list café or lobby hours.
note.zh: 酒店官网没写咖啡区和大堂时间。

note.en: Described as free and reliable; speed not reported.
note.zh: 都说免费又稳定，但没人测过网速。

note.en: Tables, sofas and a fireplace (2024).
note.zh: 有桌椅、沙发和壁炉（2024年）。

note.en: Described as airy and good for focused work.
note.zh: 被形容为通透安静，适合专注。

blurb.en: Light-filled industrial lobby in LIC with tables, sofas, a fireplace and free Wi-Fi. Non-guests grab coffee at the ground-floor café.
blurb.zh: LIC 的工业风酒店大堂，采光很好，有桌子、沙发和壁炉，免费 Wi-Fi。非住客在一楼咖啡区买杯咖啡就行。

en: Non-guests are expected to buy coffee or a drink.
Lobby bar happy hour (4–7pm weekdays per a 2019 article) can get busier.
zh: 非住客最好买杯咖啡或者饮料。
工作日4到7点有 happy hour（2019年的信息），那时可能会热闹些。

note.en: Free QPL Wi-Fi, even outside after hours; speed not reported.
note.zh: 免费QPL wifi，闭馆后在门口也能连，网速没测。

note.en: Multiple charging outlets in the renovated lower-level computer center.
note.zh: 新装修的地下一层电脑区有好几个充电插座。

note.en: The computer center has tables meant for reading and laptop use.
note.zh: 电脑区有专门看书和用电脑的桌子。

blurb.en: Astoria branch renovated in 2024, with a new lower-level computer center that has laptop tables, charging outlets and restrooms. Free Wi-Fi. Opens late on Tuesday and Thursday.
blurb.zh: Astoria的这家分馆2024年翻新过，地下一层新开了电脑区，有能用笔记本的桌子、充电插座和厕所。免费wifi，周二周四开门比较晚。

en: Closed Sundays; opens at 1pm Tuesday and noon Thursday.
Closes at 6pm most weekdays and 5pm Saturday.
zh: 周日不开，周二下午1点、周四中午12点才开门。
工作日大多6点就关门，周六5点关。

note.en: Free BPLUNWIRED Wi-Fi at every branch per BPL; speed not documented.
note.zh: BPL所有分馆都有免费Wi-Fi（BPLUNWIRED），官方没写网速。

note.en: BPL says the Main Hall reading circle has plenty of power outlets; other areas not described.
note.zh: 官方说主厅阅读区插座很多，其他区域没写。

note.en: Main hall seating plus co-working seating throughout the library, per BPL.
note.zh: 主厅有座位，整栋馆还分布着co-working座位（官方说法）。

note.en: The branch even lends laptops for in-library use.
note.zh: 这家还能借笔记本在馆内用。

note.en: Private meeting rooms: book online with an adult library card, 30 min to 2 hours, at least 2 days ahead, no commercial use.
note.zh: 有独立会议室：用成人借书证网上预约，每次30分钟到2小时，至少提前2天，不能商用。

blurb.en: Brooklyn Heights branch on Cadman Plaza West with a main hall of seating, private meeting rooms you can reserve with a library card, and in-library laptop loans. Open Sundays.
blurb.zh: Cadman Plaza 旁的分馆，大厅有座位，用借书证就能约独立会议室，还能借电脑在馆里用。周日也开。

en: Tuesday opens at 1pm; Sunday only 1-5pm.
Meeting rooms need an adult library card and 2 days' notice; max 2 hours.
zh: 周二下午1点才开门，周日只开1点到5点。
会议室要成人借书证、至少提前2天约，最多2小时。

name: Brooklyn Public Library – Central Library
nameZh: 布鲁克林公共图书馆总馆

note.en: Free BPLUNWIRED Wi-Fi at every branch per BPL; speed not documented.
note.zh: BPL所有分馆都有免费Wi-Fi（BPLUNWIRED），官方没写网速。

note.en: Info Commons invites you to plug in your laptop; outlet count not given.
note.zh: Info Commons官方说可以插电用电脑，具体插座数量没写。

note.en: 5,500 sq ft Info Commons with laptop seating, plus reading rooms.
note.zh: 一楼Info Commons约5500平方英尺，有专门的电脑座位，另外还有阅览室。

note.en: Via a booked meeting room (up to 8 people).
note.zh: 需要预约会议室，最多可坐8人。

note.en: Meeting rooms and 2-person booths; adult card needed, 2-hour max, 2 bookings a month, up to 28 days ahead.
note.zh: 可约会议室和双人小隔间，需要成人借书卡，每次最多2小时，每月最多约2次，可提前28天预约。

blurb.en: Brooklyn's flagship library at Grand Army Plaza. The first-floor Info Commons is a free co-working space with laptop seating, and you can book meeting rooms for up to 8.
blurb.zh: 布鲁克林总馆，就在Grand Army Plaza。一楼的Info Commons是免费的共享办公区，可以带电脑，还能预约最多8人的会议室。

en: Sunday hours are short (1–5pm), and Fri/Sat it closes at 6pm.
Room bookings need an adult BPL card; 2 hours max, 2 per month.
zh: 周日只开1点到5点，周五周六6点就关门。
预约会议室要有BPL成人借书卡，每次最多2小时，每月2次。

note.en: Wi-Fi is reported but its speed hasn't been measured.
note.zh: 有Wi-Fi，但网速没人实测过。

note.en: Spacious room that feels a bit like a mini coworking space.
note.zh: 空间很大，有点像迷你共享办公室。

blurb.en: Roomy roaster cafe across from the Navy Yard. It has Wi-Fi and a mini-coworking feel, with people on laptops, though turnover is high.
blurb.zh: Navy Yard对面的烘焙咖啡馆，空间宽敞，有Wi-Fi，氛围有点像小型共享办公室，常有人开电脑干活。客流量大，翻台快。

en: High turnover, so tables aren't always wiped. Check for crumbs and spills before setting your laptop down.
Opens at 6am on weekdays, but closes at 7pm every day.
zh: 客人进进出出很多，桌子不一定擦干净，放电脑前先看一眼。
工作日早上6点就开门，不过每天晚上7点关门。

note.en: A June 2025 guide says it's open until 9pm on weekdays; no full schedule found.
note.zh: 2025年6月的攻略说工作日开到晚上9点，完整营业时间没找到。

note.en: Free Wi-Fi on its own network per 2025 and 2026 guides; nobody rates the speed.
note.zh: 2025、2026年的攻略都说有自己的免费Wi-Fi，但没人说网速怎么样。

note.en: A June 2025 guide says lots of outlets; a 2023 review saw them along the walls and in booths.
note.zh: 2025年6月的攻略说插座很多；2023年的测评也说墙边和卡座都有。

note.en: Two rooms mixing couches, wicker-chair tables, stools and a bar counter.
note.zh: 两个区，沙发、藤椅桌、高脚凳和吧台都有。

note.en: A 2023 review found pop music at shop-floor volume under high ceilings; not rechecked since.
note.zh: 2023年的测评说放流行歌，层高又高，有点吵；之后没有新说法。

note.en: Fine by day, but it turns into a wine bar at night, when a Sept 2026 guide suggests putting the laptop away.
note.zh: 白天随便开电脑，晚上变成酒吧，2026年9月的攻略建议那时候就收起电脑。

note.en: A 2023 review said even a short call meant stepping outside.
note.zh: 2023年的测评说哪怕短电话也得出门打。

note.en: One single-stall restroom with a door code (2023 review).
note.zh: 只有一个单人洗手间，要密码（2023年测评）。

blurb.en: Plant-filled Chelsea cafe with a zig-zag floor, couches and outlets along the walls. Cafe by day, wine bar at night, with Middle Eastern salads and pies to snack on.
blurb.zh: Chelsea一家绿植超多的咖啡店，黑白折线地板很出片，有沙发，墙边一排插座。白天咖啡晚上酒吧，中东沙拉和菠菜派可以当饭吃。

en: Turns into a wine bar at night; laptops feel out of place then.
Music can be loud; step outside for calls.
zh: 晚上变酒吧，再开电脑就有点格格不入。
音乐可能偏大声，打电话得去外面。

note.en: From a July 2023 article; current hours not confirmed.
note.zh: 来自2023年7月的报道，现在的营业时间没核实到。

note.en: About 30 seats per a 2023 opening article.
note.zh: 2023年开业报道说大约30个座位。

blurb.en: Mexican-leaning East Williamsburg cafe with strong Wi-Fi and big breakfast burritos; weekdays it's a mix of laptop workers and coffee dates.
blurb.zh: East Williamsburg 的墨西哥风咖啡馆，网速快，早餐 burrito 很顶饱。工作日一半人在开电脑，一半在约会喝咖啡。

en: Hours we found (8am–4pm daily) are from 2023; check their Instagram first.
Likely closes mid-afternoon, so not an all-day spot.
zh: 查到的营业时间（每天8点到4点）是2023年的，去之前先看下他们 IG。
大概下午就关门，不适合待一整天。

note.en: Café hours aren't on the official page (it lists only banking hours). AwardWallet (Aug 2026) gives 7:30am–7pm; the weekend 9am–6pm comes only from a July 2023 visit report.
note.zh: 官网只写银行服务时间，没写咖啡馆时间。AwardWallet（2026年8月）写7:30到晚7点；周末9点到6点只来自2023年7月的探店文，可能变了。

note.en: Reviewers say it works well with no complaints and you can use it as long as you like.
note.zh: 测评说网很稳，想用多久用多久。

note.en: Feb 2025 review: plugs in every corner. Official page confirms free outlets.
note.zh: 2025年2月的测评说每个角落都有插座，官网也写了提供免费插座。

note.en: Lots of varied seating: two- and four-tops plus large tables.
note.zh: 座位很多类型也多，有2人桌、4人桌和大桌。

note.en: Some background chatter; airport-lounge feel.
note.zh: 有点背景人声，像机场贵宾室的感觉。

note.en: Free Wi-Fi, outlets and bookable workspaces are part of the official offer.
note.zh: 官方就提供免费Wi-Fi、插座和可预约的工位。

note.en: Nooks for private calls or meetings.
note.zh: 有小隔间可以打电话或开会。

note.en: Large tables for bigger groups (Feb 2025).
note.zh: 有大桌适合多人（2025年2月信息）。

note.en: Nooks are reservable only by Capital One account holders 18+, via QR code or the app; community room for nonprofits/student/alumni groups at most cafés.
note.zh: 小隔间只有18岁以上的Capital One账户持有人能约，扫门上二维码或用App预约；多数门店还有社区活动室给非营利/学生/校友组织用。

note.en: One review says one customer-only bathroom; another says 'lots of bathrooms'.
note.zh: 一篇说只有一个顾客专用洗手间，另一篇说洗手间很多，说法不一。

blurb.en: Bank-run cafe by Bloomberg with lots of varied seating, free Wi-Fi and outlets, plus call nooks. No purchase pressure; feels like an airport lounge.
blurb.zh: Bloomberg大楼旁边的银行咖啡馆，座位多、免费Wi-Fi和插座，还有能打电话的小隔间。不消费也没压力，像机场贵宾室。

en: Café hours aren't on the official page; third-party reports say about 7:30am–7pm weekdays and 9–6 weekends.
Bookable nooks are for Capital One account holders only.
Cardholders get 50% off drinks.
zh: 官网没写咖啡馆营业时间；第三方说工作日大概7:30到晚7点，周末9点到6点。
可预约的小隔间只限Capital One账户持有人。
用Capital One卡买饮品五折。

note.en: Only bank-service hours are posted (weekdays 9-5, Sat 9-12); café hours not found.
note.zh: 官网只写了银行业务时间（工作日9-5，周六9-12），咖啡区营业时间没查到。

note.en: Free Wi-Fi confirmed by Capital One and West Side Rag (Nov 2025); one user review calls it strong, but speed hasn't been measured.
note.zh: Capital One官网和West Side Rag（2025年11月）都确认有免费Wi-Fi，有用户说网速很好，但没人实测过。

note.en: Built for co-working; everyone is welcome, Capital One customer or not.
note.zh: 本来就是按共享办公设计的，不是Capital One客户也欢迎。

note.en: Nooks are bookable by Capital One account holders (18+). A free community room for 8 is bookable only by nonprofits and student or alumni groups.
note.zh: 小隔间只有Capital One账户持有人（18岁以上）能预约；8人社区会议室免费，但只对非营利组织、学生和校友团体开放。

blurb.en: A bank-run café built for co-working near Columbus Circle: free Wi-Fi, outlets everywhere, and bookable nooks. Everyone can sit; cardholders get half-off drinks.
blurb.zh: Columbus Circle 附近银行开的咖啡馆，专门为办公设计：免费Wi-Fi，插座到处都是，还有可预约的小隔间。谁都能来坐，持卡人饮品半价。

en: Booking a nook requires a Capital One account.
Café hours aren't posted online.
zh: 预约小隔间要有Capital One账户。
网上查不到咖啡区营业时间。

note.en: Official page lists only branch-service hours (Mon–Fri 9–5, Sat 9–12), not café hours.
note.zh: 官网只写了银行服务时间（周一到五9-5，周六9-12），没写咖啡馆营业时间。

note.en: Free Wi-Fi for everyone per Capital One; speed not reported.
note.zh: 官方写明所有人都能用免费Wi-Fi，网速没人测过。

note.en: Called the spot with more outlets than anywhere in the city (Mar 2025).
note.zh: 2025年3月有文章说这里插座多到全纽约第一。

note.en: Booths, desks, armchairs and stools across multiple floors (Mar 2025).
note.zh: 多层楼，卡座、书桌、扶手椅、高脚凳都有（2025年3月信息）。

note.en: Free Wi-Fi, outlets and workspaces are part of the official offer; no purchase needed.
note.zh: 官方就提供免费Wi-Fi、插座和工位，不消费也可以。

note.en: Nooks are reservable only by Capital One account holders 18+, via QR code or the app.
note.zh: 小隔间只有18岁以上的Capital One账户持有人能约，扫二维码或用App预约。

busyTimes.en: Can get crowded; arrive early, especially on Sundays.
busyTimes.zh: 人会比较多，最好早点来，周日尤其。

blurb.en: Multi-floor bank cafe off Union Square with booths, desks and armchairs, free Wi-Fi and a famously huge number of outlets. No purchase required.
blurb.zh: 联合广场旁的多层银行咖啡馆，卡座、书桌、沙发都有，免费Wi-Fi，插座多到夸张。不消费也能坐。

en: Café hours aren't posted online; the official page only shows banking hours.
Bookable nooks are for Capital One account holders only.
Gets crowded; Sundays fill up early.
zh: 官网没写咖啡馆营业时间，只写了银行服务时间。
可预约的小隔间只限Capital One账户持有人。
人多，周日要早点去占座。

note.en: Official visit page lists the Café & Bar 9am–8pm daily; Half Half Travel (Sep 2026) says 11am–8pm. Indoor seating can close ~5–5:30pm on event days.
note.zh: 官网写咖啡馆每天 9am–8pm，但 Half Half Travel（2026年9月）写的是 11am–8pm。有作者活动的日子，室内座位大概 5 点就关。

note.en: Wi-Fi comes with a café purchase. A 2025 review called speeds unlimited, with a 3-hour session cap.
note.zh: 买杯咖啡就能连 Wi-Fi，2025 年测评说网速没问题，但一次限 3 小时。

note.en: A 2025 reviewer found about four outlets tucked into the bookshelves.
note.zh: 2025 年测评只在书架里找到大概 4 个插座，充电别指望。

note.en: Four 8-seat communal tables, several 3-tops, plus extra seating in the adjoining auditorium.
note.zh: 四张 8 人长桌加若干三人桌，隔壁 auditorium 还有更多座位。

note.en: Sources disagree: Half Half and BK Mag describe heads-down quiet; WFHishNYC (2025) says the double-height ceiling carries conversations.
note.zh: 说法不一：Half Half 和 BK Mag 说大家都在埋头干活很安静；WFHishNYC（2025）说层高很高，聊天声会传开。

note.en: The 3-hour cap applies to the Wi-Fi session (2025 review), not necessarily to seating.
note.zh: 3 小时是 Wi-Fi 的限制（2025 年测评），不一定是座位限时。

note.en: A Sept 2026 guide says the vibe is quiet and you won't see people taking stand-up meetings.
note.zh: 2026年9月的攻略说这里氛围很安静，没人在这儿开站会。

blurb.en: Literary nonprofit's bookstore café across from BAM: big communal tables, overflow seating in the auditorium, and a bookish heads-down crowd. Outlets are scarce.
blurb.zh: BAM 对面的文学书店咖啡馆，长桌很多，隔壁 auditorium 还能坐，大家都在安静看书干活。就是插座很少，记得带满电。

en: Indoor seating often closes around 5–5:30pm on author-event nights; check the events calendar.
Wi-Fi needs a café purchase and was capped at 3 hours (2025).
Only a handful of outlets, hidden in the bookshelves.
Upstairs reading room and Writers Studio are members-only.
zh: 有作者活动的晚上，室内座位大概 5 点到 5 点半就关，去之前先看活动日历。
要消费才能连 Wi-Fi，2025 年时限 3 小时。
插座就几个，藏在书架里。
楼上阅览室和 Writers Studio 只对会员开放。

note.en: Hours required for the covered atrium under its POPS agreement; it can close from mid-afternoon for up to 12 events a year.
note.zh: 这是POPS协议规定的室内中庭开放时间；每年最多可以为12场活动从下午提前关闭。

note.en: Required: 169-214 movable seats and 47-56 movable tables (APOPS data as of March 2023).
note.zh: 按规定有169-214把可移动椅子、47-56张可移动桌子（APOPS 2023年3月数据）。

note.en: POPS rules require roughly 47–56 movable tables and 169–214 movable chairs, so small groups can pull seats together; the listing is from March 2023 and not verified on site.
note.zh: 按POPS规定这里有大约47–56张可移动桌子、169–214把可移动椅子，几个人拼一桌没问题；不过这是2023年3月的资料，没实地核实。

blurb.en: Covered public atrium in Citigroup Center, home to The Hugh food hall. Required to keep 170+ movable seats, dozens of tables and public restrooms. Free, no purchase needed.
blurb.zh: Citigroup Center里的室内公共中庭，The Hugh美食广场就在这里。按规定要有170多个可移动座位、几十张桌子和公共厕所。免费，不消费也能坐。

en: Can close from mid-afternoon for private events (up to 12 a year)
Wi-Fi and outlets not confirmed
Food hall stalls keep shorter hours than the atrium
zh: 每年最多12次因私人活动下午提前关门
Wi-Fi和插座还没确认
美食广场的店关门比中庭早

note.en: canteenM, the lobby café, is open 24/7 per the hotel site and an Aug 2025 guide; non-guest access late at night is unconfirmed.
note.zh: 酒店官网和2025年8月的攻略都说大堂的canteenM是24小时营业；非住客深夜能不能进没确认。

note.en: Free internet per older/undated articles; speed not reported.
note.zh: 之前的文章说有免费网，网速没提，信息比较旧。

note.en: Communal tables and design seating; no recent detail on how many.
note.zh: 有公共长桌和设计款座椅，具体多少没最新信息。

note.en: Locals were welcome to work here per 2019 coverage; no recent confirmation of non-guest access.
note.zh: 2019年的报道说欢迎本地人来办公，最近有没有对非住客开放没确认。

note.en: societyM meeting and coworking spaces can be booked; these are paid, not free.
note.zh: societyM的会议室和办公区可以预订，但要付费，不是免费的。

blurb.en: Midtown design hotel lobby with high ceilings, bookshelves and communal tables, plus a 24-hour cafe (canteenM). Non-guest policy is unconfirmed, so check first.
blurb.zh: Midtown的设计酒店大堂，层高很高，有书墙和公共长桌，还有24小时咖啡吧canteenM。不确定对非住客是否开放，去之前最好先确认。

en: Non-guest access unconfirmed; other citizenM locations have reportedly charged. Ask at the desk.
Times Square location means heavy tourist traffic nearby.
Bookable societyM meeting rooms cost money.
zh: 不确定非住客能不能免费用，据说别的citizenM分店收过费，最好先问前台。
在时代广场旁边，周边游客超多。
societyM会议室可以订，但是收费的。

note.en: Official site; daytime is coffee hall, evenings become a cocktail hall.
note.zh: 官网时间；白天是咖啡厅，晚上变成鸡尾酒吧。

note.en: Plugs beside nearly every seating cluster along the outer walls.
note.zh: 靠外墙的座位区基本都有插座。

note.en: High ceilings carry sound; bring headphones (2024 review).
note.zh: 挑高很高，声音会传，建议带耳机（2024 年测评）。

note.en: Three communal tables seating eight each.
note.zh: 有三张 8 人长桌。

note.en: Daytime coffee seating is first come, first served; only evening tables take Resy reservations.
note.zh: 白天咖啡时段先到先得，只有晚上的座位能在Resy上订。

blurb.en: Art deco former bank hall turned coffee-and-cocktail hall: green lamps, couches, three 8-seat communal tables, fast Wi-Fi and plenty of plugs. Not quiet.
blurb.zh: 老银行大厅改的咖啡厅+酒吧，复古绿台灯、沙发，还有三张 8 人长桌。网快插座多，适合约人开会，但不算安静。

en: Not a quiet room: the soaring ceiling carries chatter, so bring headphones.
Evenings switch to a cocktail hall with Resy reservations; daytime coffee is first come, first served.
Weekend brunch runs 10am–3pm.
zh: 挑高大厅很吵，记得带耳机。
晚上变成鸡尾酒吧，要在 Resy 订位；白天咖啡先到先得。
周末 10am–3pm 有 brunch。

note.en: No current hours found.
note.zh: 没找到最新营业时间。

note.en: Fast in a 2023 test; a 2026-updated guide confirms free Wi-Fi.
note.zh: 2023年实测网速快，2026年更新的攻略确认还有免费Wi-Fi。

note.en: One outlet on a column in a 2023 review.
note.zh: 2023年测评说只有柱子上一个插座。

note.en: Small room, mostly two-tops and high stools.
note.zh: 店面小，大多是两人桌和高脚凳。

note.en: A 2023 review found it quiet; a 2026 guide calls it bustling.
note.zh: 2023年测评说挺安静，2026年攻略说比较热闹，说法不一。

note.en: Only one four-person table; the rest are mostly two-tops.
note.zh: 只有一张四人桌，其余基本是两人桌。

blurb.en: Small West Village cafe with a big sunny window and free Wi-Fi. Good for an hour or two, but the seats aren't built for a full day.
blurb.zh: West Village的小咖啡馆，大窗户采光很好，有免费Wi-Fi。适合待一两个小时，椅子不太舒服，不建议坐一整天。

en: Seats aren't ergonomic; better for a short session than a full day.
Very few outlets; arrive charged.
Small room, so staying all day can feel awkward.
zh: 椅子不太舒服，适合短时间办公，不适合一坐一整天。
插座极少，记得充满电。
店面小，坐一整天会有点不好意思。

name: David Rubenstein Atrium at Lincoln Center

note.en: Free Wi-Fi reported by Lonely Planet (undated); speed not measured.
note.zh: Lonely Planet提到有免费Wi-Fi（没写日期），网速没实测。

note.en: POPS rules require 152 chairs and 38 tables, but Lincoln Center's own page now says seating is limited and first-come, first-served.
note.zh: 按POPS规定要有152把椅子、38张桌子，但Lincoln Center官网现在写的是座位有限、先到先得。

note.en: Movable tables can be pulled together.
note.zh: 桌子可以移动，能拼桌。

note.en: Accessible, gender-neutral restrooms.
note.zh: 有无障碍、不分性别的洗手间。

busyTimes.en: Free performances, often Thursday evenings, fill the room and limit seating.
busyTimes.zh: 有免费演出的时候（经常是周四晚上）人很多，座位会被占满。

blurb.en: Lincoln Center's free public atrium, with lots of tables and chairs, restrooms and a café. Open late every day; free shows can take over the room.
blurb.zh: Lincoln Center的免费公共中庭，桌椅很多，有洗手间和咖啡店，每天开到晚上10点。有免费演出时会比较吵。

en: Free performances (often Thursdays) bring crowds and noise, and seating goes first-come during events.
The in-house café is only open Tue–Sat 9am–5pm.
Outlets unconfirmed.
zh: 有免费演出时（经常是周四）人多又吵，座位先到先得。
里面的咖啡店只在周二到周六9点到17点营业。
插座情况没确认。

note.en: Free, password-protected Wi-Fi on weekdays; it is switched off on weekends. Speed not reported.
note.zh: 工作日有免费Wi-Fi，要密码；周末直接关掉。网速没人测过。

note.en: Only source is a Jan 2024 article.
note.zh: 只有一篇2024年1月的文章提到，信息偏旧。

note.en: Background music, but most people are working so there is little chatter.
note.zh: 有背景音乐，但大家基本都在干活，很少有人聊天。

note.en: Wi-Fi is shut off on weekends to keep it laptop-free; plan to work Mon–Fri. The 2015 source may refer to another branch.
note.zh: 周末关Wi-Fi，就是不想让人开电脑久坐，建议周一到周五来。2015年那篇可能说的是别的分店。

blurb.en: Bright Devoción with 18-ft windows and an indoor tropical garden. Weekdays it's a calm room of people working to background music; on weekends the Wi-Fi goes off.
blurb.zh: 18英尺落地窗+室内热带植物园，颜值超高。工作日基本都是安静干活的人，配着背景音乐；周末关Wi-Fi，别来办公。

en: Wi-Fi is turned off on weekends.
Closes at 6pm every day.
zh: 周末不开Wi-Fi。
每天下午6点就关门。

note.en: Undated listing tags it work-friendly and suggests arriving at opening if you plan to work; no written laptop rules found.
note.zh: 一个没写日期的榜单标了“适合办公”，建议想久坐干活就开门就去；没找到店里的电脑规定。

blurb.en: Landmarked former artist's studio with exposed brick and a big skylight over the bar. Free Wi-Fi and plenty of outlets make it a freelancer favorite; smaller than the Williamsburg flagship.
blurb.zh: 老艺术家工作室改的店，红砖墙加大天窗，光线超好。免费Wi-Fi，插座多，自由职业者很爱来。比Williamsburg旗舰店小一些。

en: Weekends get busy; go on a weekday if you need quiet
Closes at 6pm
zh: 周末人多，想安静就工作日去
晚上6点就关门

note.en: Clocked ~180 Mb/s (May 2026). Older reports say Wi-Fi is switched off on weekends; not confirmed recently.
note.zh: 2026 年 5 月测速约 180Mb/s。以前有说法周末关 Wi-Fi，最近没法确认。

note.en: Outlets run along the wall seats.
note.zh: 插座主要在靠墙那排座位。

note.en: The big skylit room amplifies sound.
note.zh: 天窗大空间，声音容易被放大。

note.en: Recommended for laptop work by several guides; weekend Wi-Fi shutoff reported in older sources.
note.zh: 很多指南都推荐来办公；但早年有周末关 Wi-Fi 的说法。

note.en: Not great for calls: the room carries sound.
note.zh: 不适合打电话，空间回音大。

busyTimes.en: Packed every morning; arrive before 9am for an outlet seat. After 10am it's a gamble.
busyTimes.zh: 每天早上都爆满，想要插座位 9 点前到，10 点以后就看运气了。

blurb.en: Colombian roaster's greenhouse-like café under a big skylight, with plants, leather sofas and wall seats with outlets. Fast Wi-Fi, but mornings fill up fast.
blurb.zh: 哥伦比亚烘焙品牌，天窗大玻璃房，满屋绿植和皮沙发。网速快，靠墙有插座，但早上人超多，要早点去占座。

en: Older reports say Wi-Fi is turned off on weekends; bring a hotspot just in case.
Not a calls spot: the room amplifies voices.
Sources list both 69 and 148 Grand St; double-check before you go.
zh: 以前有周末关 Wi-Fi 的说法，周末去最好带热点。
不适合打电话，声音会被放大。
地址有 69 Grand St 和 148 Grand St 两种说法，出发前再确认一下。

note.en: Consistent, never dropped in many sessions; reaches the patio.
note.zh: 网很稳，泡了很多次从没掉线，户外座也有信号。

note.en: Outlet at 13 of 14 indoor tables.
note.zh: 室内14张桌子13张有插座。

note.en: About 14 two-person tables, 3 window stools, plus 9 patio tables.
note.zh: 大约14张两人桌、3个窗边高脚凳，外加9张户外桌。

note.en: Rarely loud; seating is away from the counter, music at moderate volume.
note.zh: 很少吵，座位离点单区远，音乐音量适中。

note.en: During weekend brunch, all tables are held for dine-in from the brunch menu.
note.zh: 周末早午餐时段所有桌子只给点brunch堂食的人。

note.en: Reviewer flags two corner tables behind a column as good for meetings.
note.zh: 博主推荐角落柱子后面的两张桌子，适合开会。

note.en: Almost all two-tops.
note.zh: 基本都是两人桌。

note.en: The cafe says it does not take reservations; tables are first come, first served.
note.zh: 店家官网说不接受预约，座位先到先得。

note.en: One single-occupancy restroom, no code.
note.zh: 一个单人洗手间，不用密码。

blurb.en: Hell's Kitchen cafe near Clinton park with an outlet at nearly every table, steady Wi-Fi (even on the patio) and calm music. Mostly two-tops, so best solo or in pairs.
blurb.zh: Hell's Kitchen的宝藏咖啡馆，几乎每张桌子都有插座，网很稳，户外座也能连。音乐不吵，基本都是两人桌，适合一个人或两个人来。

en: Weekend brunch: tables held for brunch dine-in only.
Closes at 5pm daily.
Almost all two-person tables; not for groups.
zh: 周末早午餐时段桌子只留给点brunch的堂食客人。
每天5点关门。
几乎全是两人桌，不适合多人。

note.en: Fast Wi-Fi and printer access (undated article).
note.zh: 网速快，还能打印（文章没写日期）。

note.en: Couches plus tables usable as desks.
note.zh: 有沙发，也有能当书桌用的桌子。

note.en: Can accommodate small business gatherings during the day.
note.zh: 白天可以容纳小型商务聚会。

blurb.en: Hotel lounge at Dream Midtown with fast Wi-Fi, couches and desk-height tables; complimentary coffee and tea have been reported. Turns into a cocktail lounge at happy hour.
blurb.zh: Dream Midtown酒店的lounge，网速快，有沙发和能办公的桌子，有说会提供免费咖啡和茶。到了happy hour就变成鸡尾酒吧。

en: Becomes a cocktail lounge at happy hour.
Ordering food or drinks is the polite norm; free coffee not reconfirmed.
Hours not confirmed.
zh: Happy hour开始就变成酒吧了。
礼貌起见点点东西，免费咖啡没再确认。
营业时间没查到。

note.en: Called fast in a Jan 2024 guide; a Sept 2026 guide confirms Wi-Fi but doesn't rate speed.
note.zh: 2024年的文章说网速快；2026年的攻略只确认有Wi-Fi，没说快不快。

note.en: Only a Jan 2024 source mentions plentiful outlets.
note.zh: 只有2024年初的文章提到插座多，最近没有新的说法。

blurb.en: Minimalist Bushwick cafe with a roomy indoor dining area that regulars treat as a daily office. Wi-Fi, bagel sandwiches and breakfast burritos; Spectrum coffee.
blurb.zh: Bushwick的极简风咖啡店，室内座位宽敞，很多熟客天天来这办公。有Wi-Fi，贝果三明治和早餐卷饼都好吃。

en: Current hours unconfirmed; listings disagree, and some show a ~4–5pm close. Check before heading over.
zh: 营业时间没找到官方版本，各家说法不一，有的写下午4-5点就关门，去之前最好先确认。

note.en: ATLY (Oct 2026) lists Wi-Fi; it's also in The Infatuation's 'coffee shops with wifi' guide (Sep 2026). Speed not stated.
note.zh: ATLY（2026年10月）写了有wifi，The Infatuation 2026年9月的「有wifi的办公咖啡馆」榜单也收了它，网速没写。

note.en: Listed for 'getting work done'; no written laptop policy found.
note.zh: 被列为适合办公的咖啡馆，但没找到店家明确的电脑规定。

blurb.en: All-day Goan cafe on Jay Street: chai, coffee and small plates, usually quiet and sunny. Turns into a wine bar later in the day.
blurb.zh: Jay St上的果阿风全天咖啡馆，有印度奶茶、咖啡和小食。平时挺安静，阳光很好，傍晚之后更像小酒馆。

en: Dinner menu starts at 5pm, so evenings lean toward wine and food rather than laptops.
Outlets and full hours not confirmed (a listing says it opens at 7:30am); check before a long session.
zh: 下午5点后换晚餐菜单，晚上更适合喝酒吃饭，不太适合开电脑。
插座和完整营业时间没查到（有平台说早上7:30开门），久坐前最好先确认。

note.en: Sources conflict: a 2024 article lists daily 7:30am opening, and a current listing shows Thu–Sun only. Check before going.
note.zh: 营业时间说法不一：2024年的报道说每天7:30开门，现在的一个列表又写只开周四到周日。去之前一定确认。

note.en: Large tables, couch lounges and a rooftop.
note.zh: 有大桌、沙发休息区，还有天台。

note.en: Large tables; exact size not stated.
note.zh: 有大桌子，具体能坐几个人没说。

blurb.en: Big LIC cafe-bar with large tables, couch lounges and a rooftop. It's aimed at remote workers during the day and turns into a bar and speakeasy at night.
blurb.zh: LIC的大型咖啡酒吧，有大桌、沙发区和天台。白天主打远程办公，晚上变成酒吧和地下酒吧。

en: Hours are inconsistent, and it may be closed Mon–Wed. Confirm before you go.
Wi-Fi unconfirmed.
zh: 营业时间不统一，周一到周三可能不开，出门前先确认。
Wi-Fi没确认。

name: Greenpoint Library and Environmental Education Center

note.en: Free BPLUNWIRED Wi-Fi at every branch per BPL; speed not documented.
note.zh: BPL所有分馆都有免费Wi-Fi（BPLUNWIRED），官方没写网速。

note.en: The branch even lends laptops for in-library use.
note.zh: 这家分馆还能借笔记本电脑在馆内使用。

note.en: Small meeting rooms and a large community space, reserved through BPL's room reservation site.
note.zh: 有小会议室和大的社区活动空间，可在布鲁克林图书馆官网预约。

blurb.en: Eco-minded Greenpoint branch with lounge seating, a planted reading deck, small meeting rooms you can reserve, and laptop loans. Open Sundays.
blurb.zh: Greenpoint的环保主题图书馆，有休闲座位和种满植物的户外阅读平台，小会议室可以预约，还能借电脑。周日也开门。

en: Opens at 1pm on Tuesdays and Sundays; Sunday closes at 5pm.
Free BPL Wi-Fi, but speed and outlets are not listed on the branch page.
zh: 周二和周日下午1点才开门，周日5点就关。
有BPL免费Wi-Fi，但网速和插座情况官网都没写。

note.en: A June 2025 guide calls the Wi-Fi solid; a Sept 2026 guide relays reports that it's too slow for video calls.
note.zh: 2025年6月的攻略说网还行；2026年9月的攻略说有人反映网太慢，视频会议带不动。

note.en: Communal tables plus a back room with library-style armchairs and couches.
note.zh: 有公共长桌，后面还有一间像图书馆的扶手椅/沙发区。

note.en: A June 2025 guide describes a calm but productive vibe; a 2026 guide likens the couches to a library.
note.zh: 2025年6月的攻略说氛围安静又有干活的劲儿；2026年的攻略说沙发区像图书馆。

note.en: Based on reports that the Wi-Fi can't handle video calls, not on a house rule.
note.zh: 因为网可能带不动视频会议，不是店里规定。

note.en: Communal tables suggest a small group can sit together; table size not stated.
note.zh: 有公共长桌，小团体应该能坐一起，但没说桌子多大。

blurb.en: Hell's Kitchen coffee shop with library vibes: communal tables up front and a back room of armchairs and books. Open 7am to 7pm every day.
blurb.zh: Hell's Kitchen一家图书馆风的咖啡店，前面是长桌，后面一间摆满扶手椅和书。每天早7点到晚7点。

en: Wi-Fi reports are mixed; bring a hotspot for video calls.
zh: 网速评价两极，要开视频会议最好带热点。

note.en: Directory listings disagree (closing at 3pm, 6pm, 7pm or 8pm), and the venue site lists no hours.
note.zh: 各个网站写的营业时间对不上（下午3点到晚上8点都有），官网也没写。

note.en: Only an undated listing mentions wifi.
note.zh: 只有一个没标日期的网站提到有wifi。

note.en: Mostly long shared tables, packed in close.
note.zh: 基本是长条共享桌，座位挨得很近。

blurb.en: Long-running SoHo coffee shop with warm, neighborhood energy. You'll likely share a long table elbow to elbow, and there are outlets, but not much room to spread out.
blurb.zh: SoHo的老牌咖啡店，氛围很温暖有人情味。基本坐长条共享桌，跟旁边的人挨得很近。有插座，但没地方铺开摊子。

en: Tight on space, so not great for long sessions.
zh: 空间挤，不太适合久坐。

name: Hex & Co.
address: 2911 Broadway (at W 114th St), New York, NY

note.en: Official site offers free Wi-Fi with any café purchase (opening–5pm on weekdays); speed not stated.
note.zh: 官网说工作日开门到下午5点，买任意饮品就能免费用wifi，网速没写。

note.en: Most tables are free during the day when gamers aren't using them.
note.zh: 白天没人玩桌游，大部分桌子都空着。

note.en: Official site: free seating and Wi-Fi with a café purchase from opening to 5pm every weekday (gameplay excluded). Evenings and weekends are not covered by this offer.
note.zh: 官网写的是：工作日开门到下午5点，买杯饮品就能免费坐、用wifi（玩桌游另算）。晚上和周末不在这个范围内。

blurb.en: Board game cafe near Columbia that serves La Colombe coffee and light food. By day most game tables sit empty, which makes it a roomy place to sit with a coffee or a small group.
blurb.zh: Columbia旁边的桌游咖啡馆，咖啡是La Colombe，也有简餐。白天玩桌游的人少，大桌子基本都空着，一个人或几个朋友来坐都很宽敞。

en: Free seating and Wi-Fi only with a café purchase, weekdays from opening to 5pm; after that tables are for paid gameplay.
Outlets unconfirmed; charge up first.
Tables are meant for gamers, so expect them to fill in the evenings.
zh: 工作日开门到下午5点，买饮品才能免费坐、蹭wifi；5点以后桌子留给付费玩桌游的。
插座没确认，最好充满电再来。
桌子主要是给玩桌游的，晚上大概率会满。

note.en: Hours of the lobby Intelligentsia coffee bar; the lobby itself may stay open later.
note.zh: 这是大堂 Intelligentsia 咖啡吧的营业时间，大堂本身可能开得更久。

note.en: The hotel advertises its 'fastest free Wi-Fi'; not independently tested.
note.zh: 酒店自己宣传「最快免费Wi-Fi」，没有第三方实测。

note.en: Guides say guests and non-guests work in the lobby, but the main source is from 2019.
note.zh: 指南说住客和非住客都在大堂办公，但主要来源是2019年的。

note.en: An undated guide says the lobby nooks suit online meetings; no venue policy found.
note.zh: 一篇没标日期的攻略说大堂角落适合开线上会，酒店没有明确规定。

blurb.en: Chelsea hotel by the High Line with an Intelligentsia coffee bar in the lobby, banquettes and sofas, and a garden courtyard in good weather.
blurb.zh: High Line 旁边的酒店，大堂里有 Intelligentsia 咖啡吧，卡座和沙发都能坐，天气好还能去花园。

en: Coffee bar closes at 5pm.
Lobby-work tolerance is based on older reports; buy a coffee.
zh: 咖啡吧下午5点关。
能不能在大堂久坐主要是旧资料说的，最好点杯咖啡。

note.en: Free Wi-Fi; one speed test logged ~13 Mbps down.
note.zh: 有免费Wi-Fi，有人测过下载约13Mbps，够用但不快。

note.en: No outlets listed.
note.zh: 基本没有插座。

note.en: One listing says moderate noise; another calls it good for quiet laptop work.
note.zh: 有的说噪音中等，有的说适合安静办公，看时段。

note.en: Listed as suitable for laptop work; no official policy found.
note.zh: 被列为适合开电脑的地方，没找到官方规定。

blurb.en: Two-level used bookstore on Crosby St with a small cafe in back serving coffee, beer and wine. Free Wi-Fi but no outlets, so arrive charged.
blurb.zh: Crosby St上超有氛围的二手书店，后面有小咖啡吧卖咖啡、啤酒和红酒。有免费Wi-Fi但没插座，带满电来。

en: No outlets; come fully charged.
Opens at 11am and closes 5pm on Sundays.
Space is rented for weddings and private events.
zh: 没有插座，记得充满电。
11点才开门，周日5点就关。
场地会出租办婚礼和私人活动。

note.en: From NYPL page search snippets (nypl.org blocks fetching); an older NYPL copy showed 11–5. Closed Sundays and holidays.
note.zh: 来自NYPL官网的搜索摘要（官网打不开）；旧版页面写的是11点到5点。周日和节假日不开。

note.en: NYPL says every location has free, password-free Wi-Fi (network "NYPL") in public areas whenever it's open; speed not reported, and the network isn't secure.
note.zh: NYPL官方说所有分馆开放时间内公共区域都有免费Wi-Fi（连"NYPL"，不用密码）。网速没人测过，而且是不加密的公共网络。

blurb.en: Small two-story 1906 Carnegie library at Leroy St and 7th Ave, with tall arched windows. Reopened in January 2024 after flood repairs.
blurb.zh: 1906年的卡内基老图书馆，在Leroy街和第七大道路口，两层楼，拱形高窗很好看。2024年1月修完水灾后重新开放。

en: Closed Sundays; Saturdays end at 5pm.
Seating and outlets not confirmed.
zh: 周日不开，周六下午5点就关。
座位和插座情况还没确认。

note.en: Long a Columbia study spot; the shop says you can sit as long as you like, but there is no Wi-Fi and few outlets.
note.zh: Columbia学生的老牌自习点，店家说想坐多久坐多久，但没Wi-Fi、插座也少。

note.en: The shop's site says you can sit as long as you like; a Nov 2025 West Side Rag piece says nobody will bother you for hours.
note.zh: 官网说想坐多久就坐多久；West Side Rag 2025年11月也说坐几个小时都没人管。

blurb.en: Old-school Viennese-style pastry shop by Columbia with lots of tables and bottomless coffee. No Wi-Fi and few outlets, so it's best for offline writing or reading.
blurb.zh: Columbia旁边的老牌维也纳风甜品店，桌子多，咖啡无限续杯。没有Wi-Fi，插座也少，适合断网写东西、看书。

en: No Wi-Fi at all; bring a hotspot
Outlets are scarce, so charge before you go
zh: 完全没有Wi-Fi，要自带热点
插座很少，记得充满电再去

name: Hunters Point Library
address: 47-40 Center Blvd, Long Island City, NY 11109

note.en: Free QPL Wi-Fi with no sign-in, reachable about 450 ft from the building even when closed; speed unknown.
note.zh: 有免费 QPL Wi-Fi，不用登录，闭馆时在楼外约140米内也能连，网速未知。

note.en: Public library with free Wi-Fi and remote printing.
note.zh: 公共图书馆，免费Wi-Fi，还能远程打印。

blurb.en: Steven Holl's waterfront library with Manhattan skyline views through big carved windows, reading areas on cantilevered floors and rooftop bleacher seating. Free, open Sundays.
blurb.zh: Steven Holl 设计的江边图书馆，大块异形窗正对曼哈顿天际线，悬挑楼层是阅读区，顶楼还有阶梯座位。免费，周日也开。

en: Tuesday opens at 1pm; most days close at 6pm.
Outlets and study-room availability unconfirmed.
zh: 周二下午1点才开，大部分日子6点就关。
插座和自习室情况没查到。

note.en: Free Wi-Fi per ICP; speed not reported.
note.zh: ICP 官方说有免费 Wi-Fi，网速没人测。

note.en: ICP lists stations for plugging in laptops.
note.zh: 官方说有给电脑充电的插座位。

note.en: ICP explicitly invites people to sit and work.
note.zh: 官方明确欢迎来坐着办公。

blurb.en: ICP's free ground-floor café: free Wi-Fi, laptop charging stations and lots of room to sit and work, next to a free photo exhibition space.
blurb.zh: ICP 一楼的免费公共空间咖啡馆：免费 Wi-Fi，有给电脑充电的地方，座位很多，旁边还有免费摄影展区。

en: Closes at 5:30pm (7:30pm Thursdays).
Museum galleries upstairs are paid; the café floor is free.
zh: 楼上展厅要买票，一楼咖啡区免费。

note.en: Official pages disagree: 9am–9pm on the visit page and footer, 8am–10pm in the FAQ text.
note.zh: 官网自己说法不一：有写9am-9pm，也有写8am-10pm。

note.en: Industry City advertises free campus-wide public Wi-Fi (its own amenities page and Wi-Fi terms of use). Speed and courtyard coverage not independently tested.
note.zh: 官网写园区全覆盖免费公共Wi-Fi（有专门的Wi-Fi使用条款），但网速和庭院信号没人实测过。

note.en: Official FAQ: day visitors are welcome to use common lobby spaces and courtyards.
note.zh: 官方FAQ说散客可以随意使用公共大堂和庭院。

note.en: Courtyards are open for guest gatherings.
note.zh: 庭院欢迎大家聚会使用。

note.en: Free Freelancers Hub seats (241 37th St) can be booked up to 8 days a month after a free sign-up; weekdays 9am–5pm (Sept 2026 guide).
note.zh: 241 37th St的Freelancers Hub免费注册后每月可以订8天免费工位，工作日9点到5点（2026年9月攻略）。

note.en: Public restrooms on the ground floors of buildings 2–6.
note.zh: 2-6号楼一楼有公共洗手间。

blurb.en: Sprawling Sunset Park campus where day visitors can use the lobbies and courtyards for free, with a food hall and public restrooms on site. Good for a group work day out.
blurb.zh: Sunset Park超大的创意园区，大堂和庭院免费开放给访客，有美食广场和公共洗手间，适合约朋友一起来泡一天。

en: Free campus Wi-Fi is advertised, but coverage in every courtyard is unverified; a hotspot is a good backup.
Courtyards are outdoors, so weather-dependent.
Official hours conflict (9am–9pm vs 8am–10pm).
Cowork IC on campus is paid coworking, not the free areas.
Free Freelancers Hub desks: sign up and book ahead, weekdays 9–5 only, 8 days a month max.
zh: 官方说有园区免费Wi-Fi，但不保证每个庭院都有信号，带个热点更稳。
庭院在户外，看天气。
官网营业时间说法不一（9-9或8-10）。
园区里的Cowork IC是付费共享办公，不是免费区域。
Freelancers Hub免费工位要先注册再预约，只开工作日9-5点，每月最多8天。

note.en: Mon–Thu 10am–7pm, Fri–Sat 10am–5pm, closed Sunday, seen only in search snippets of NYPL pages (one a mirror copy); nypl.org blocks automated reads. An older directory listed Sunday 1–5pm.
note.zh: 周一到周四10点到晚7点，周五周六10点到5点，周日不开。只在NYPL页面的搜索摘要里看到（其中一个是镜像页），官网打不开。有个旧目录写周日下午1-5点开，去之前确认。

note.en: NYPL says every location has free Wi-Fi (open "NYPL" network, no password, not secure). Nobody reports the speed at this branch.
note.zh: NYPL官方说所有分馆都有免费Wi-Fi（网络名"NYPL"，不用密码，但不加密）。这家分馆的网速没人测过。

note.en: Opening coverage (June 2024) mentions quiet study and reading areas; not re-checked recently.
note.zh: 2024年6月开馆报道提到有安静的自习区和阅读区，最近没再核实。

blurb.en: New 20,000 sq ft NYPL branch on the first two floors of The Eliza, opened June 2024, with quiet study areas, co-working space and a teen center.
blurb.zh: 2024年6月新开的NYPL分馆，在The Eliza楼的一二层，面积2万平方英尺。有安静自习区、共享办公区和青少年中心。

en: Hours are from search snippets only; check nypl.org before going, especially on Sundays.
zh: 开放时间只来自搜索摘要，去之前查一下nypl.org，周日尤其要确认。

note.en: Sources conflict (one guide says no Wi-Fi at any location; a newer review says it now has Wi-Fi). Waiting for an in-person check.
note.zh: 说法不一（有攻略说所有门店都没 Wi-Fi，较新的评论说现在有了），等实地确认。

note.en: A Sept 2026 guide says laptops are tolerated (with your own hotspot) only at the Upper West Side shop; nothing specific for this location.
note.zh: 2026年9月的攻略说只有 UWS 那家默许开电脑（要自带热点），这家没有明确说法。

note.en: Guide advises against loud calls or meetings at Irving Farm shops in general.
note.zh: 攻略建议在 Irving Farm 各家店都别大声打电话或开会。

blurb.en: Roomy, wood-lined Irving Farm by Washington Square Park with plenty of seats. Wi-Fi reports conflict, so treat it as a hotspot spot.
blurb.zh: 华盛顿广场旁边的 Irving Farm，木质装修，座位多。Wi-Fi 有没有说法不一，建议当成自带热点的地方。

en: Closes at 5pm every day.
Calls and meetings are discouraged.
zh: 每天下午5点就关门。
不太欢迎打电话和开会。

name: Jefferson Market Library
address: 425 Avenue of the Americas, New York, NY 10011

note.en: OpenStreetMap: community-mapped opening hours
note.zh: OpenStreetMap：社区维护的营业时间

note.en: Free 'NYPL' Wi-Fi with no password or card at every NYPL branch during open hours (June 2026 guide); speed at this branch not reported.
note.zh: NYPL所有分馆开放时间都有免费Wi-Fi（网络名NYPL，不用密码也不用借书证，2026年6月的攻略）；这家分馆网速没人测过。

note.en: ADA-accessible restrooms rebuilt in the 2022 renovation (2022 source).
note.zh: 2022年翻修时重建了无障碍洗手间（2022年的信息）。

blurb.en: NYPL branch in a landmark Victorian courthouse, renovated in 2022 with better power and data. The second-floor Adult Reading Room is the old civil courtroom.
blurb.zh: NYPL分馆，在一栋地标级维多利亚老法院里，2022年翻修后电力和网络都升级了。二楼成人阅览室以前是民事法庭，超有氛围。

en: Check nypl.org for current hours before going; we couldn't verify them.
zh: 去之前先上nypl.org查开放时间，我们没核实到。

note.en: Hotel site lists no lobby or bar hours.
note.zh: 酒店官网没写大堂和酒吧时间。

note.en: Wi-Fi available in the Living Room and plaza; speed not reported. Hotel site says free Wi-Fi is for IHG members.
note.zh: Living Room 和户外广场都有 Wi-Fi，但网速没人测过。官网说免费 Wi-Fi 是给 IHG 会员的。

note.en: Bar is a few feet from the seating.
note.zh: 酒吧就在座位旁边。

note.en: No reservation needed to work in the Living Room.
note.zh: 在 Living Room 办公不需要预约。

note.en: Conference rooms and event spaces through the hotel's events team (paid).
note.zh: 会议室和活动场地要找酒店活动部预订（收费）。

blurb.en: Cozy fireplace 'Living Room' behind the lobby where you can work without a reservation, with Wi-Fi and a bar steps away. Outdoor plaza in good weather.
blurb.zh: 大堂后面的 Living Room 有壁炉，不用预约就能坐下办公，有 Wi-Fi，旁边就是吧台。天气好可以去后面的户外广场。

en: The bar is right next to the seating, so it gets lively.
Free Wi-Fi is officially for IHG members; bring a hotspot.
zh: 吧台就在旁边，会比较热闹。
官方说免费 Wi-Fi 给 IHG 会员，最好自带热点。

note.en: The Instagram bio lists 7am–7pm for the roastery shop with no per-day breakdown, so we assume daily.
note.zh: Instagram简介写的烘焙店是早7点到晚7点，没分周几，按每天营业算。

note.en: Lots of seating inside and out.
note.zh: 室内外座位都很多。

blurb.en: Kinship's Astoria roastery café: strong wifi, lots of seating indoors and out, and house-roasted single origins. One of the few work spots in the area open until 7pm.
blurb.zh: Kinship在Astoria的烘焙店，网速很好，室内外座位都多，还卖自家烘的单品豆。营业到晚上7点，在附近算关门晚的了。

en: Free public cupping Mondays at 10:30am, so it may be busier then.
zh: 周一上午10:30有免费杯测活动，那会儿可能人比较多。

note.en: OpenStreetMap: community-mapped opening hours (checked 2026-06-12)
note.zh: OpenStreetMap：社区维护的营业时间（2026-06-12 核对）

note.en: Free Wi-Fi reported (June 2025); speed not rated. A March 2025 source says weekend Wi-Fi use is limited.
note.zh: 2025年6月的攻略说有免费Wi-Fi，网速没人具体说；2025年3月有文章说周末Wi-Fi有限制。

note.en: One source says 'plenty', another 'several spread throughout'.
note.zh: 一篇说插座很多，另一篇说分布在各处，数量不少。

note.en: Both sources describe it as peaceful and focused.
note.zh: 两篇都说很安静、适合专注。

note.en: Weekend Wi-Fi use is limited (Mar 2025); weekdays are best for work.
note.zh: 周末Wi-Fi有限制（2025年3月的信息），工作日来最合适。

note.en: Some tables suit group work; exact sizes not stated.
note.zh: 有些桌子适合小组一起学习，具体能坐几人没说。

blurb.en: Roomy East Village cafe with lots of tables, outlets spread around the room and a calm, focused feel. Best on weekdays before lunch.
blurb.zh: 东村一家空间挺大的咖啡馆，桌子多、插座分布广，氛围安静适合专注。工作日午饭前来最稳。

en: Wi-Fi is limited on weekends.
Fills up quickly after lunch, so come early.
zh: 周末Wi-Fi有限制。
午饭后很快坐满，建议早点来。

note.en: Fast per a 2023 review; not rechecked.
note.zh: 2023年的测评说网速快，之后没复查。

note.en: Outlets under the front seats (2023).
note.zh: 前排座位下面有插座（2023年）。

note.en: Seven two-tops, a four-top in back and more tables upstairs (2023).
note.zh: 七张双人桌，后面一张四人桌，楼上还有桌子（2023年）。

note.en: High ceilings carry nearby conversations.
note.zh: 层高很高，旁边聊天声会传过来。

note.en: One four-person table in back.
note.zh: 后面有一张四人桌。

note.en: One single-occupancy restroom.
note.zh: 只有一个单人洗手间。

blurb.en: Small cafe a block from Grand Central with fast Wi-Fi, outlets under the front seats, and extra tables upstairs. Good for a work session between trains.
blurb.zh: 离Grand Central一个街区的小咖啡店，网速快，前排座位下有插座，楼上还有桌子。等车前后来干会儿活很方便。

en: All details come from a 2023 review, and we couldn't confirm it's still open.
Just one single-stall restroom.
zh: 信息都来自2023年的测评，我们没法确认它现在还开着。
只有一个单人洗手间。

note.en: The café's own site lists 8am–5pm every day, matching a 2023 guide. Half Half (Sep 2026) mentions food served until 7pm; trust the official hours.
note.zh: 官网写的是每天早8点到下午5点，和2023年的攻略一致。Half Half（2026年9月）提到供餐到晚上7点，还是以官网为准。

note.en: The café's site has a "Wifi Policy" section, so Wi-Fi exists, but no speed is given and a 2024 report says it's restricted during the noon–3pm rush.
note.zh: 官网有"Wifi Policy"一栏，说明有Wi-Fi，但没写网速；2024年有报道说中午12-3点高峰会限制。

note.en: Described as spacious with many seating options (Jan 2024).
note.zh: 2024年初的文章说空间大、座位选择多。

note.en: Official policy: laptops only in certain areas Mon–Fri 12–3pm and Sat–Sun 10am–4pm; unrestricted at other times.
note.zh: 官网规定：工作日12-3点、周末10-4点只能在指定区域用电脑，其他时间随便用。

blurb.en: Roomy corner cafe on 5th Ave at Garfield with plenty of seating. Laptops are fine most of the day but confined to certain areas at lunch and on weekend daytimes.
blurb.zh: 5th Ave和Garfield路口的转角咖啡馆，空间大座位多。大部分时间随便开电脑，午饭点和周末白天只能坐指定区域。

en: Laptops limited to certain areas Mon–Fri 12–3pm and Sat–Sun 10am–4pm.
Wi-Fi has been restricted during the noon–3pm lunch rush (2024 report).
Closes at 5pm daily.
zh: 工作日12-3点、周末10-4点，电脑只能在指定区域用。
2024年有报道说中午12-3点午餐高峰会限制Wi-Fi。
每天下午5点就关门。

note.en: From the cafe's own website, which is undated; confirm before a long session.
note.zh: 来自店家官网，但官网没写更新日期，去之前最好再确认一下。

note.en: Classic rock plays, but at a level where a phone call still works.
note.zh: 会放经典摇滚，但音量不大，打电话没问题。

note.en: A Sept 2026 guide says laptops are a common sight; no written policy found.
note.zh: 2026年9月的攻略说店里开电脑的人很多，没找到明文规定。

blurb.en: Airy Bushwick cafe with lots of room, strong Wi-Fi and background music low enough for calls. Good pastries, including vegan loaves, but not a full-lunch spot.
blurb.zh: Bushwick一家很通透的咖啡店，空间大、网速稳，背景音乐不吵，能直接打电话。甜点不错还有纯素款，但正经午饭就别指望了。

en: Closes at 6pm weekdays and 5pm weekends.
Food is mostly pastries; plan lunch elsewhere.
zh: 工作日6点、周末5点就关门，别太晚去。
吃的基本只有甜点，午饭得另外解决。

note.en: OpenStreetMap: community-mapped opening hours
note.zh: OpenStreetMap：社区维护的营业时间

note.en: OpenStreetMap: Wi-Fi available; speed not recorded
note.zh: OpenStreetMap：有 Wi-Fi，网速未记录

note.en: Tables along the walls and windows plus a big communal table in the middle; outdoor seats in spring/summer.
note.zh: 靠墙靠窗一圈小桌，中间一张大长桌，春夏还有户外座位。

note.en: Described as busy inside; no detail on volume.
note.zh: 攻略说店里比较忙，具体吵不吵没细说。

note.en: Laptop users mostly gather at the center communal table.
note.zh: 开电脑的人基本都坐中间那张大长桌。

note.en: Has a large communal table, but no source says how many can reliably sit together.
note.zh: 有张大长桌，但没查到能稳定坐几个人。

blurb.en: Neighborhood all-day spot where laptop folks share the big communal table in the middle. Stays open into the evening, with rotisserie chicken after 4pm.
blurb.zh: 社区型全天咖啡馆，开电脑的人都坐中间那张大长桌。营业到晚上，下午4点后还有烤鸡。

en: Wi-Fi and outlets unconfirmed; the room can get busy.
zh: Wi-Fi和插座情况没查到，店里人可能比较多。

note.en: A July 2024 guide says Wi-Fi is offered for remote workers; speed not rated and not rechecked since.
note.zh: 2024年7月的攻略说有给远程办公的Wi-Fi，网速没人说，之后也没新消息。

note.en: A Sept 2026 guide calls it laptop-friendly but says nothing about weekends; a July 2024 guide says weekends are laptop-free. Check for signs on weekends.
note.zh: 2026年9月的攻略说适合开电脑，但没提周末；2024年7月的攻略说周末不让开电脑。周末去先看看有没有告示。

blurb.en: Turkish-leaning daytime cafe on Roebling with Turkish pastries and bagels; works for a laptop session in the morning before it shifts to wine and beer later in the day.
blurb.zh: Roebling街上的土耳其风小咖啡馆，有土耳其面包和贝果。上午适合开电脑干活，下午就变成喝酒的氛围了。

en: Shifts to wine and beer in the afternoon, and it's often booked for private events
Weekends have been reported as laptop-free
Outlets and seating are not confirmed
zh: 下午开始卖酒，也常被包场办活动
有人说周末不让开电脑
插座和座位情况都还没确认

note.en: A 2019 guide says locals and guests may use the Wi-Fi; speed not stated and not reconfirmed since.
note.zh: 2019年的指南说本地人和住客都能用wifi，网速没写，之后也没再确认。

note.en: Described in 2025 as serene, more private club than busy hotel.
note.zh: 2025年的文章说很安静，更像私人会所而不是热闹酒店。

note.en: Older guides say non-guests are welcome to work in the lobby; no hotel policy found.
note.zh: 老一点的指南说非住客也可以在大堂办公，没找到酒店官方说法。

blurb.en: Living-room lobby on the Lower East Side: leather sofas around a big limestone fireplace, plus a garden. Calm and clubby, best for a quiet solo session.
blurb.zh: LES 的客厅式酒店大堂：石砌大壁炉旁一圈皮沙发，还有小花园。安静、有会所感，适合一个人安静工作。

en: Lounge seating, not desks.
Non-guest welcome is from older guides; ordering from the bar is the polite move.
zh: 都是沙发，不是书桌。
非住客能坐的说法来自旧资料，最好在吧台点点东西。

note.en: Laptops OK on weekdays; no laptops or tablets on weekends.
note.zh: 工作日可以开电脑，周末不让用电脑和平板。

blurb.en: Bright little Yorkville cafe at 94th and 2nd with small round tables and a wall bench. Laptops are fine on weekdays and there are a decent number of outlets.
blurb.zh: Yorkville的小咖啡馆，在2大道和94街，明亮干净，小圆桌加靠墙长凳。工作日可以开电脑，插座还算够用。

en: No laptops or tablets on weekends
Small tables; the wall bench fills up fast
Closes at 4pm on weekdays
zh: 周末不让用电脑和平板
桌子小，靠墙长凳的位置很抢手
工作日下午4点就关门

note.en: A 2022 article listed Tue–Fri 7–4 and Sat–Sun 8–4, with longer hours 'coming soon'. We found no current hours.
note.zh: 2022年的报道写的是周二到周五7–4点、周末8–4点，还说会延长营业时间，目前没找到最新营业时间。

note.en: 2022 source: the tables along one wall are lined with outlets.
note.zh: 2022年的信息：靠墙一排桌子都有插座。

note.en: 2022 source: wall tables plus a central island.
note.zh: 2022年的信息：靠墙一排桌子，中间还有个中岛。

blurb.en: Second outpost of a Harlem coffee favorite, in the front of a converted garage that houses the Harlem Collective co-working space. Outlet-lined wall tables and a big central island.
blurb.zh: Harlem人气咖啡店的二店，开在一个旧车库改的共享办公空间前厅。靠墙一排桌子都有插座，中间有个大中岛。

en: Our seating and outlet info dates from 2022, and current hours are unconfirmed. Check Instagram before you go.
Wifi and laptop policy are unconfirmed.
zh: 座位和插座信息来自2022年，营业时间也没确认，去之前先看下Instagram。
wifi和能不能开电脑都还没确认。

note.en: OpenStreetMap: community-mapped opening hours
note.zh: OpenStreetMap：社区维护的营业时间

note.en: Lobby Wi-Fi open to freelancers per a 2019 article.
note.zh: 2019年的文章说大堂Wi-Fi对自由职业者开放。

note.en: Outlet access is limited.
note.zh: 插座很少。

note.en: Leather armchairs around a fireplace and a few small tables.
note.zh: 壁炉边几张皮扶手椅，加几张小桌子。

note.en: Long known as a freelancer and writer hangout; no posted policy found.
note.zh: 一直是自由职业者和写作者爱来的地方，没找到明文规定。

blurb.en: Cozy wood-paneled lobby with a fireplace, leather armchairs and an espresso bar. It's a longtime freelancer and writer haunt, but there are only a few small tables.
blurb.zh: 木质装修的复古大堂，有壁炉、皮沙发和意式咖啡吧，一直是写作者和自由职业者的据点。不过桌子少，就几张小桌。

en: Few outlets, so charge up first.
Only a few small tables; mostly armchairs.
Work-related info is mostly from 2019 or older.
zh: 插座很少，记得先充满电。
桌子少，大多是扶手椅。
关于办公的信息大多是2019年或更早的。

note.en: Hours of Bar Bedford, the lobby bar (coffee by day, cocktails at night); lobby itself not listed.
note.zh: 这是大堂吧Bar Bedford的时间（白天咖啡、晚上鸡尾酒），大堂本身没写。

note.en: Free Wi-Fi all day; speed not measured.
note.zh: 全天免费Wi-Fi，网速没实测。

note.en: Time Out calls the lobby great for computer work, and Marriott pitches Bar Bedford as a spot for coffee and co-working by day.
note.zh: Time Out说大堂很适合开电脑，Marriott官网也把Bar Bedford定位成白天喝咖啡、办公的地方。

blurb.en: Hotel lobby in Williamsburg with free all-day Wi-Fi and a bar-restaurant. Time Out calls it a great place for computer work, and coffee is free in the morning.
blurb.zh: Williamsburg的酒店大堂，全天免费Wi-Fi，楼下有餐吧。Time Out说很适合开电脑工作，早上还有免费咖啡。

en: Complimentary coffee only 7–10am (per Time Out, 2025).
Seating and outlets unconfirmed; it turns into a cocktail bar in the evening.
zh: 免费咖啡只有早上7点到10点（Time Out 2025年的说法）。
座位和插座没确认；晚上会变成鸡尾酒吧。

name: Moxy NYC Downtown (Recreation)
address: 26 Ann St, 3rd Floor, New York, NY

note.en: Open network that worked well (2023 review).
note.zh: 开放网络不用密码，好用（2023年信息）。

note.en: Outlets under the bar, by couches and bar seats (2023).
note.zh: 吧台下、沙发旁都有插座（2023年）。

note.en: Two-tops, a 12-seat long table, two lounge areas and bar seats (2023).
note.zh: 有两人桌、12人长桌、两块沙发区和吧台（2023年）。

note.en: Often loud: bar, restaurant and games like skee-ball and shuffleboard.
note.zh: 经常很吵，有酒吧、餐厅，还有各种游戏机。

note.en: Pitched as daytime laptop space in 2021 and reviewed as a WFH spot in 2023; no current venue policy found.
note.zh: 2021年的报道说白天可以开电脑办公，2023年也有人当办公点测评过；现在的官方规定没查到。

note.en: Long table seats 12.
note.zh: 长桌能坐12人。

note.en: Two single-occupancy gender-neutral restrooms.
note.zh: 两个单人无性别洗手间。

blurb.en: Third-floor hotel lounge off Broadway with a 12-seat long table, couches, lots of outlets and open Wi-Fi. Fun for group sessions, but games and a bar keep it loud.
blurb.zh: FiDi的Moxy酒店三楼，有12人长桌、沙发、很多插座，Wi-Fi不用密码。适合一群人来，但有酒吧和游戏，比较吵。

en: Only a 2023 review found; current hours and access not reconfirmed.
Loud: bar plus arcade-style games.
Expect to buy food or drinks.
zh: 只找到2023年的测评，现在营业时间和开放情况没再确认。
很吵，有酒吧还有游戏。
最好点点吃的喝的。

note.en: NYC 311 says all public library locations have free Wi-Fi during open hours; a June 2026 guide says the 'NYPL' network needs no password. Speed not tested.
note.zh: NYC 311官网说所有公共图书馆开放时间都有免费Wi-Fi；2026年6月的攻略说连「NYPL」就行，不用密码。网速没人实测。

blurb.en: NYPL's Carnegie branch on W 23rd St in Chelsea, reopened in Sept 2025 after about three years of construction. Free to use, with free library Wi-Fi.
blurb.zh: Chelsea 23街的NYPL卡内基老分馆，施工了差不多三年，2025年9月重新开放。免费进，有图书馆免费Wi-Fi。

en: Hours, outlets and seating unverified; check nypl.org before going.
zh: 开放时间、插座和座位都还没核实，去之前看下nypl.org。

note.en: From two NYPL page search snippets (nypl.org blocks fetching); older listings differ. Closed Sundays.
note.zh: 来自两个NYPL官网页面的搜索摘要（官网打不开），旧的资料写法不一样。周日不开。

note.en: NYPL says every location has free, password-free Wi-Fi (network "NYPL") in public areas whenever it's open; speed not reported, and the network isn't secure.
note.zh: NYPL官方说所有分馆开放时间内公共区域都有免费Wi-Fi（连"NYPL"，不用密码）。网速没人测过，而且是不加密的公共网络。

note.en: 2023 source.
note.zh: 2023年的信息。

note.en: The lower-level adult reading rooms are meant for quiet individual study (2022–23 sources).
note.zh: 地下的成人阅览室是给安静自习用的（2022–23年的信息）。

blurb.en: NYPL branch in a converted chocolate factory. Downstairs, brick-walled adult reading rooms have work tables, comfy seats, and outlets, and stay calm and uncrowded.
blurb.zh: 旧巧克力工厂改的NYPL分馆。地下是红砖墙的成人阅览室，有大桌子、舒服的座位和插座，人不多，很安静。

en: Closed Sundays; Fri–Sat close at 5pm.
Work details come from 2022–23 sources.
zh: 周日不开，周五周六下午5点关门。
环境信息来自2022–23年的资料。

note.en: Infatuation calls the Wi-Fi good; no speed test.
note.zh: Infatuation说网不错，但没有测速。

note.en: Mostly metal stools; the plant-filled back area usually has a table free.
note.zh: 大多是金属高脚凳，后面种满植物的区域一般能找到一张桌子。

blurb.en: Cafe tucked inside Mushtari Hardware & Garden on 125th. Good Wi-Fi, great playlists and a leafy back room; light snacks and cookies rather than full meals.
blurb.zh: 藏在125街Mushtari五金园艺店里的咖啡角。网不错，歌单很好听，后面有个满是绿植的小区域。只有小零食和饼干，没有正餐。

en: Seating is mostly metal stools, so not ideal for a long day.
No full meals, just snacks and cookies.
Hours not confirmed.
zh: 座位大多是金属凳，坐久了不舒服。
没有正餐，只有小点心和饼干。
营业时间没查到。

note.en: Generally fast; one 2024 review says it can drop in and out.
note.zh: 网速整体挺快，但2024年有人反映偶尔会掉线。

note.en: Both sources are from 2024: outlets along the main table, near the 4-top and in the nooks.
note.zh: 两个来源都是2024年的：大长桌一头、四人桌旁和角落沙发区都有插座。

note.en: Music overhead, and people take meetings here.
note.zh: 有背景音乐，也常有人在这里开会聊天。

note.en: People take meetings here, so a call won't stand out.
note.zh: 常有人在这里开会，打电话不会显得突兀。

note.en: A single bathroom in the back (2024 source).
note.zh: 后面只有一个单人洗手间（2024年的信息）。

blurb.en: Bushwick coffee-and-craft-beer parlour with a big communal table, couch nooks, and lots of outlets. Fast wifi, music on, and a bar crowd with events after dark.
blurb.zh: Bushwick的咖啡+精酿小店。中间一张大长桌，角落有沙发卡座，插座多，网速快。白天适合办公，晚上变酒吧，还有各种活动。

en: Turns into a bar at night with events most evenings (trivia Wednesdays at 7pm, comedy, jazz).
Big windows with no curtains mean harsh afternoon glare on the communal table.
Closes at 6pm on Sundays.
zh: 晚上变酒吧，几乎每晚都有活动（周三7点trivia、喜剧、爵士），想安静办公白天去。
落地窗没有窗帘，下午大长桌那边阳光很刺眼。
周日下午6点就关门。

note.en: No current hours found.
note.zh: 没找到最新营业时间。

note.en: Fast in a 2023 test; newer listings only confirm free, password-protected Wi-Fi.
note.zh: 2023年的实测网速很快；最近的攻略只提到有免费Wi-Fi、需要密码。

note.en: A handful of outlets on one wall (2023 review).
note.zh: 2023年的测评说只有一面墙上有几个插座。

note.en: A 2023 count found about a dozen seats; a 2025 guide says there are plenty.
note.zh: 2023年测评数下来大概十几个座位，2025年的攻略却说座位很多，说法不一。

note.en: A Sept 2026 guide calls it known for being good for working; no written laptop rules found.
note.zh: 2026年9月的攻略说这家出了名的适合办公，没看到店里有限制电脑的规定。

note.en: Shared table for four plus a three-seat couch (2023).
note.zh: 有一张四人共享桌和一张三人沙发（2023年信息）。

note.en: The space can be booked for events or meetings, not a separate room.
note.zh: 整个店面可以预订办活动或开会，不是单独的会议室。

blurb.en: Bright, wood-lined cafe near Canal St with couches, big windows and good music. Wi-Fi is quick, outlets are scarce, and the whole space can be booked for meetups.
blurb.zh: Canal St附近的木质风咖啡馆，有沙发，落地窗采光超好，音乐也好听。网速快但插座少，整个场地还能预订来办小聚会。

en: Only a handful of outlets, all on one wall; come charged.
Wi-Fi is password-protected; ask at the counter.
zh: 插座很少，只集中在一面墙，记得充满电再去。
Wi-Fi有密码，点单时问店员。

name: 53rd Street Library
nameZh: 纽约公共图书馆 53街分馆

note.en: Mon–Sat 11am–6pm, closed Sunday, per a search snippet of the official NYPL page (nypl.org blocks automated reads, so the page itself wasn't opened). Holiday hours differ.
note.zh: 周一到周六上午11点到下午6点，周日不开。来自NYPL官网页面的搜索摘要（官网屏蔽了自动访问，没能直接打开）。节假日时间会变。

note.en: NYPL says every location has free Wi-Fi (open "NYPL" network, no password, not secure). Nobody reports the speed at this branch.
note.zh: NYPL官方说所有分馆都有免费Wi-Fi（网络名"NYPL"，不用密码，但不加密）。这家分馆的网速没人测过。

note.en: Opened in 2016 with a 10-stool laptop bar; current layout not re-checked.
note.zh: 2016年开馆时有一个10个座位的电脑吧台，现在是否还这样没再确认。

blurb.en: Modern NYPL branch across from MoMA, with oak bleacher-style seating that steps down into a sunken reading room. Opened in 2016 with a laptop bar.
blurb.zh: MoMA对面的NYPL分馆，设计很现代，橡木阶梯座位一路往下通到地下阅览室。2016年开馆时就有电脑吧台。

en: Seating details not confirmed; hours come from a search snippet of nypl.org, so check before you go.
Most of the library is below street level.
Closed Sundays; opens at 11am.
zh: 座位情况没确认；开放时间来自nypl.org的搜索摘要，去之前再查一下。
图书馆大部分在地下。
周日不开，早上11点才开门。

name: Battery Park City Library
address: 175 North End Ave, New York, NY 10282

note.en: Free 'NYPL' Wi-Fi with no password or card at every NYPL branch during open hours (June 2026 guide); speed at this branch not reported.
note.zh: NYPL所有分馆开放时间都有免费Wi-Fi（网络名NYPL，不用密码也不用借书证，2026年6月的攻略）；这家分馆网速没人测过。

note.en: Reviews mention ample seating with power outlets.
note.zh: 评价说座位多，有插座。

note.en: Generally calm, but kids' noise is common in this family neighborhood branch.
note.zh: 整体安静，但这里小朋友多，会有些吵闹。

note.en: One restroom; ask the front desk for the key.
note.zh: 只有一个厕所，要找前台拿钥匙。

blurb.en: Small NYPL branch with big windows over Teardrop Park and the Hudson. Free, calm and outlet-friendly, though it's a family neighborhood so expect kids.
blurb.zh: NYPL 小分馆，大窗户对着 Teardrop Park 和哈德逊河。免费、有插座、整体安静，不过周边家庭多，会有小朋友。

en: No eating or drinking inside.
Only one restroom, key from the front desk.
Can get noisy with kids.
zh: 馆内不能吃喝。
只有一个厕所，要找前台拿钥匙。
小朋友多的时候会有点吵。

name: New York Public Library for the Performing Arts
nameZh: 纽约公共图书馆表演艺术分馆
address: 40 Lincoln Center Plaza, New York, NY 10023

note.en: nypl.org blocked automated access; reading-room hours can differ from building hours.
note.zh: nypl.org没法抓取；而且阅览室时间可能和整栋楼开放时间不一样。

note.en: NYC 311 says all public library locations have free Wi-Fi during open hours; a June 2026 guide says the 'NYPL' network needs no password. Speed not tested.
note.zh: NYC 311官网说所有公共图书馆开放时间都有免费Wi-Fi；2026年6月的攻略说连「NYPL」就行，不用密码。网速没人实测。

blurb.en: NYPL's performing-arts research library inside Lincoln Center, with a third-floor research reading area. Enter from the Plaza or 111 Amsterdam Ave.
blurb.zh: NYPL表演艺术研究图书馆，就在林肯中心里面，三楼是研究阅览区。从广场或111 Amsterdam Ave都能进。

en: Coats and bags must be checked before entering the 3rd-floor research collections.
Reading-room hours can differ from building hours; check nypl.org.
zh: 进三楼研究区前要先寄存外套和包。
阅览室开放时间可能和大楼不同，去之前查一下nypl.org。

name: Stephen A. Schwarzman Building (Rose Main Reading Room)

note.en: Building hours from NYPL page snippets (nypl.org blocks fetching). Mon–Sat agree, but Sunday conflicts (1–5pm vs closed) and one snapshot showed a Monday closure. The reading room may differ from building hours; casual visitors get a 10–11am visiting hour or tours.
note.zh: 这是大楼开放时间，来自NYPL官网的搜索摘要（官网打不开）。周一到周六说法一致，周日有冲突（有的写下午1-5点，有的写不开），还有一次显示周一闭馆。阅览室时间可能跟大楼不一样，普通游客是早上10-11点参观或跟导览。

note.en: NYPL says every location has free, password-free Wi-Fi (network "NYPL") in public areas whenever it's open; speed not reported, and the network isn't secure.
note.zh: NYPL官方说所有分馆开放时间内公共区域都有免费Wi-Fi（连"NYPL"，不用密码）。网速没人测过，而且是不加密的公共网络。

note.en: 30 of the 42 tables have power; the other 12 are for reading only.
note.zh: 42张桌子里30张有电源，另外12张只能看书。

note.en: Roughly 600+ seats.
note.zh: 大约600多个座位。

note.en: Workstations were refitted for laptops; we couldn't check current NYPL rules (the site blocked fetching).
note.zh: 阅览室改造时专门加了笔记本工位；NYPL官网抓取不到，没能确认现行规定。

blurb.en: NYC's most famous reading room: a block-long hall with a painted ceiling, brass lamps, and power at most tables. Free and grand, best for solo focused work.
blurb.zh: 纽约最出名的阅览室，整整一个街区长，天花板有壁画，桌上有黄铜台灯，大部分桌子有电源。免费又震撼，适合一个人专注干活。

en: Not every table has power, so pick one of the tables that does.
Photography is limited to a small part of the room. Sunday hours conflict across sources; check nypl.org.
zh: 不是每张桌子都有电源，要挑有插座的那几排坐。
只有一小块区域可以拍照。周日开不开说法不一，去之前看nypl.org。

name: Washington Heights Library
address: 1000 St. Nicholas Ave, New York, NY 10032

note.en: Mon–Thu 10am–7pm, Fri–Sat 10am–5pm, Sun 1–5pm, per a search snippet of the official NYPL page (nypl.org blocks automated reads). An older NYPL legacy page shows shorter hours. Holiday hours differ.
note.zh: 周一到周四10点到晚7点，周五周六10点到5点，周日下午1点到5点。来自NYPL官网的搜索摘要（官网屏蔽自动访问）。NYPL旧页面写的时间更短，节假日也会变。

note.en: NYPL says every location has free Wi-Fi (open "NYPL" network, no password, not secure). Nobody reports the speed at this branch.
note.zh: NYPL官方说所有分馆都有免费Wi-Fi（网络名"NYPL"，不用密码，但不加密）。这家分馆的网速没人测过。

note.en: Renovated three public floors plus a third-floor multipurpose study room (2016).
note.zh: 三层公共楼层翻新过，三楼还有多功能自习区（2016 年）。

note.en: An 8-seat study room and a 25-seat classroom were added in 2016; booking rules unknown.
note.zh: 2016 年新增 8 人自习室和 25 人教室，能否预约不清楚。
