blurb.en: Multi-floor uptown NYPL branch renovated in the 2010s, with a teen center, computer room and a third-floor study and collaboration space. Free, but details are thin.
blurb.zh: 上城的 NYPL 多层分馆，2010 年代翻新过，有青少年区、电脑室和三楼自习协作空间。免费，但具体信息不多。

en: Hours come from a search snippet of nypl.org; check before going, especially on holidays.
zh: 开放时间来自nypl.org的搜索摘要，去之前再确认一下，节假日尤其要查。

note.en: Port Authority: street-level access to the Oculus hall is limited 1–5am. Shops and restrooms keep shorter hours.
note.zh: Port Authority官网：凌晨1点到5点地面入口限制进出。商店和洗手间的开放时间更短。

note.en: Free '!Free WTC WiFi' network; speed not documented.
note.zh: 连“!Free WTC WiFi”就行，网速没有官方说法。

note.en: There are some seating areas, but few real tables.
note.zh: 有几处座位区，但能放电脑的桌子很少。

note.en: Several public restrooms across the WTC concourses; most open roughly 9am–8pm.
note.zh: WTC各个连廊都有公共洗手间，大多大概早9点到晚8点开放。

busyTimes.en: Busiest mid-morning and mid-afternoon; quieter early morning and late evening.
busyTimes.zh: 上午十点左右和下午最挤，早上和晚上人少一点。

blurb.en: The WTC transit hall has free Wi-Fi and public restrooms, but seating is scattered and tables are rare. Fine for an email sprint between meetings, not a workday.
blurb.zh: WTC的Oculus有免费Wi-Fi和公共洗手间，但座位分散、几乎没桌子。开会间隙回几封邮件可以，坐一天不行。

en: Few tables; mostly perch-and-type.
It's a busy transit and shopping hub, so expect crowds and noise.
Restrooms are in the concourses and keep shorter hours than the building.
zh: 桌子很少，基本只能找地方凑合着打字。
这里是交通枢纽兼商场，人多又吵。
洗手间在各个连廊里，开放时间比大楼短。

note.en: Official site lists 7am–7pm (no per-day breakdown); holiday hours vary, check Instagram.
note.zh: 官网写的是每天7点到晚7点（没按星期细分），节假日会变，去之前看下IG。

note.en: Wi-Fi confirmed; no source rates its speed.
note.zh: 有wifi，但没人测过网速。

note.en: Ample indoor seating plus an outdoor yard.
note.zh: 室内座位多，还有个户外小院。

note.en: One 2026 guide says regulars work quietly, but it lists a different address, so treat with caution.
note.zh: 有篇2026的攻略说大家都安静干活，不过那篇地址写错了，仅供参考。

blurb.en: Easygoing Greenpoint coffee shop with plenty of seats inside and a back yard that's great for working when the weather cooperates. Wi-Fi available; open till 7pm.
blurb.zh: Greenpoint很chill的一家咖啡店，室内位子多，天气好可以去后院办公。有wifi，开到晚上7点。

en: The yard is outdoor seating, so it's weather-dependent.
Holiday hours vary; check their Instagram first.
zh: 后院是户外座，看天气。
节假日营业时间不固定，先看IG。

note.en: From the official store page's live schedule (Oct 2026): 7am–7pm, Sundays from 8am. The brand's Union Square landing page says weekends open at 8am, so Saturday mornings may vary.
note.zh: 官网门店页2026年10月的营业时间：每天早7点到晚7点，周日8点开。不过官网另一个介绍页写周末8点开门，周六早上可能有出入。

note.en: 'Filled with booths and power outlets' (March 2025).
note.zh: 2025年3月的报道说到处是卡座和插座。

note.en: Booths upstairs plus a basement level.
note.zh: 楼上有卡座，地下还有一层。

note.en: Described as focused, full of people studying (2025).
note.zh: 2025年的报道说大家都在学习，氛围很专注。

blurb.en: Danish bakery near Union Square with two floors of seating, booths and plenty of outlets. The study crowd keeps it focused, and the pastries are cheap.
blurb.zh: Union Square旁边的丹麦面包店，上下两层都有座，有卡座，插座也多。来这儿的基本都在学习，氛围很专注，面包也不贵。

en: If upstairs is full, head to the basement for more seats.
Closes at 7pm; Wi-Fi not confirmed for this branch.
zh: 楼上没位就去地下室，那里还有很多座位。
晚上7点关门；这家店有没有Wi-Fi还没确认。

name: Overflow Coffee
address: 46-36 Vernon Blvd, Long Island City, NY 11101

note.en: One guide says ample seating but also notes takeaway only, which conflicts with other sources describing people working inside.
note.zh: 有指南说座位很多，但同一页又说只能外带，和其他人在店里办公的说法矛盾。

blurb.en: Bright Vernon Blvd cafe with fast wifi and outlets in easy reach. Folky soundtrack, and a kids' play area tucked in the back away from the work tables.
blurb.zh: Vernon Blvd上采光超好的咖啡馆，网速快，插座顺手。放的是民谣，后面有个儿童游戏区，和办公区分开。

en: Closes at 6pm daily.
Kids' play area in the back, so expect some family traffic.
zh: 每天晚上6点就关门。
后面有儿童游戏区，会有带娃的家长进出。

note.en: BPL says free Wi-Fi (BPLUNWIRED) is available at every branch; speed here not verified.
note.zh: BPL官网说每个分馆都有免费Wi-Fi（BPLUNWIRED），这家网速没实测。

note.en: Free public Wi-Fi at all BPL branches; no laptop restrictions listed.
note.zh: BPL所有分馆都有免费Wi-Fi，没看到任何限制用电脑的规定。

note.en: Meeting rooms can be requested through BPL's room reservation site.
note.zh: 会议室可以在BPL的预约系统里申请。

note.en: ADA-accessible restroom, entered from the back entrance on Pacific St.
note.zh: 有无障碍洗手间，要从Pacific St那边的后门进。

blurb.en: Historic Carnegie branch at Fourth Ave and Pacific, near Barclays Center. Free, with meeting rooms the public can reserve. Open until 8pm on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
blurb.zh: Barclays Center旁边的百年老图书馆，免费，会议室可以预约。周二周四开到晚上8点。

en: Closed Sundays, and opens only at 1pm on Tuesdays.
Expected to close for renovation from summer 2027 to fall 2029.
zh: 周日不开，周二下午1点才开门。
预计2027年夏天开始闭馆装修，到2029年秋天才重开。

note.en: The hotel's own Eat & Drink page lists 7am–6pm daily; two 2025–26 guides say 8am, so it may open a little later in practice.
note.zh: 酒店官网写每天早7点到晚6点；两篇2025-26年的攻略说8点开门，实际可能稍晚。

note.en: Free Wi-Fi reported (Jun 2025); speed not measured.
note.zh: 有免费Wi-Fi（2025年6月），网速没人测过。

note.en: Guides describe settling in for hours or a full day.
note.zh: 指南说可以坐几个小时甚至一整天。

blurb.en: Coffee bar in the lobby of the MADE Hotel, part cafe, part hotel lounge. Calm and rustic, with free Wi-Fi and some outlets. Good for a few hours of focus.
blurb.zh: MADE Hotel 大堂里的咖啡吧，半咖啡馆半酒店lounge。氛围安静质朴，有免费Wi-Fi和几个插座，适合专注几小时。

en: Closes at 6pm.
zh: 晚上6点就关门。

note.en: Required public hours for this privately owned public space.
note.zh: 这是私有公共空间（POPS）规定的对外开放时间。

note.en: Required: 136 movable seats and 48 tables.
note.zh: 按规定要有136把可移动座椅和48张桌子。

note.en: Tables are used for studying and web surfing (2024).
note.zh: 2024年的报道说有人在桌边学习、上网。

note.en: Movable tables and chairs can be pulled together.
note.zh: 桌椅可以移动，能拼在一起。

note.en: Two accessible restrooms by the elevators.
note.zh: 电梯旁边有两个无障碍洗手间。

blurb.en: Free, climate-controlled glass atrium running from 52nd to 53rd St, with dozens of movable tables, a waterfall wall and public restrooms. Open 8am to 10pm daily.
blurb.zh: 免费的室内玻璃中庭，从52街穿到53街，有冷暖气，几十张可移动桌椅，还有瀑布墙和公共洗手间。每天早8点到晚10点开放。

en: Entrances are on 52nd/53rd between Park and Madison, not on Park Ave.
Wi-Fi and outlets unconfirmed; bring a hotspot.
zh: 入口在52街和53街（Park和Madison之间），不在Park Ave上。
Wi-Fi和插座没确认，最好自带热点。

name: Partners Coffee
address: 26-25 Jackson Ave, Long Island City, NY 11101

note.en: From the cafe's joe.coffee ordering page (undated). One aggregator says it closes at 6pm, and the official site lists no hours.
note.zh: 来自店家在joe.coffee的点单页（没写更新日期）。也有网站写6点关门，官网没写营业时间。

note.en: Reviewers call the Wi-Fi good; no speed tests.
note.zh: 评价说网络不错，但没有测速。

note.en: Big back patio; indoor seats can be hard to find when busy.
note.zh: 后院露台位置多，室内忙的时候不好找座。

note.en: Laptop-free on weekends; sources variously say indoors or the patio.
note.zh: 周末不让开电脑；有的说是室内，有的说是露台。

blurb.en: Bright, high-ceilinged Partners outpost on Jackson Ave with a backyard patio. Good Wi-Fi and a calm feel on weekdays; laptops are off-limits on weekends.
blurb.zh: Jackson Ave 上的 Partners，挑高很亮，后面还有小院子。工作日网不错、挺安静；周末不让开电脑。

en: Laptop-free on weekends.
Indoor seats can be hard to get at busy times.
Closes around 5:30pm daily.
zh: 周末禁止开电脑。
忙的时候室内很难找到座位。
每天大概5点半就关门。

note.en: From the official site; it may apply to all three UWS locations.
note.zh: 来自官网，可能是三家UWS分店通用的时间。

note.en: Has its own dedicated network; speed not reported.
note.zh: 有专门的wifi，网速没人测过。

note.en: One shared table plus smaller tables along the side.
note.zh: 一张长桌加靠边几张小桌。

note.en: No laptops on weekends.
note.zh: 周末不让开电脑。

blurb.en: Family-run UWS espresso bar with Stumptown coffee and a Balkan-leaning menu. Has its own Wi-Fi, a shared table and a few outlets. Laptops are weekday-only.
blurb.zh: UWS一家家庭经营的咖啡店，豆子用Stumptown，还有巴尔干风味的吃的。有专门的wifi、一张长桌和几个插座，但只有工作日能开电脑。

en: Laptops not allowed on weekends.
zh: 周末不让开电脑。

note.en: From an Oct 2023 guide; other listings show closes up to 6pm. Confirm before going.
note.zh: 来自2023年10月的攻略，其他地方也有写开到6点的，去之前再确认一下。

note.en: Described as 'relatively fast' in a Jan 2024 guide; nothing more recent found.
note.zh: 只有2024年初的文章说网速“还算快”，没找到更新的信息。

note.en: Jan 2024 source only.
note.zh: 只有2024年初的来源。

note.en: Jan 2024 source only.
note.zh: 只有2024年初的来源。

note.en: Jan 2024 source only.
note.zh: 只有2024年初的来源。

note.en: Older guides disagree: one calls it great for laptops, another (same publisher) says it's better for just sitting with a coffee.
note.zh: 几篇旧攻略说法不一：有的说很适合带电脑，有的说更适合坐下来喝杯咖啡。

blurb.en: Nonprofit community cafe off 5th Ave in Park Slope. Older guides praise it as a quiet spot with lots of seats, outlets and a printer customers can use.
blurb.zh: Park Slope的社区非营利咖啡店，就在5th Ave旁边。旧攻略都说挺安静，座位和插座多，还能打印东西。

en: Address is 6th Street, not 6th Avenue.
Work details come from 2023–24 sources; hours (7:30/8am–4pm) are from 2023 and may have changed.
zh: 地址是6th Street，不是6th Avenue。
办公信息都来自2023-24年的资料；营业时间（7:30/8点到下午4点）是2023年的，可能有变。

note.en: These are the hours of Louis, the ground-floor café (undated Mr & Mrs Smith listing, which gives the lobby bar as 11am–11pm). The hotel site posts no lobby hours.
note.zh: 这是一楼咖啡馆Louis的时间（Mr & Mrs Smith页面，没写日期；大堂酒吧写的是11点到晚11点）。酒店官网没写大堂开放时间。

note.en: One undated article calls it fast, and an undated hotel listing says free Wi-Fi throughout. But the hotel's own site says non-guests get Wi-Fi with a paid day pass for the rooftop Sun Club, so free lobby access for non-guests is unclear.
note.zh: 一篇没写日期的文章说网速快，另一个酒店介绍页说全酒店免费Wi-Fi。但官网写非住客要买屋顶Sun Club的日票才含Wi-Fi，所以非住客在大堂能不能免费连，说不准。

note.en: Second-floor lobby has workstations, nooks, risers, big tables and couches.
note.zh: 二楼大堂有工作台、小角落、台阶座、大桌子和沙发。

note.en: A 2024 report says laptops go away after 6pm.
note.zh: 2024年有报道说晚上6点后要收电脑。

note.en: Larger tables available on the second-floor lobby.
note.zh: 二楼有大桌子。

blurb.en: Two-level LES hotel lobby with workstations, nooks, big tables and couches up the escalator. Louis cafe downstairs for coffee. Reportedly laptops away after 6pm.
blurb.zh: LES这家酒店大堂有两层，坐扶梯上去有工作台、小角落、大桌和沙发。楼下Louis可以买咖啡。据说晚上6点后要收电脑。

en: Reported house rule: laptops away after 6pm when the lobby turns social.
Busy on weekdays and weekends alike.
zh: 据说6点以后大堂变成社交场所，要收电脑。
工作日和周末人都不少。

note.en: joe.coffee's listing (Oct 2026) gives 7am–midnight, to 1am Fri–Sat; QNS (Apr 2025) also says 7am–midnight. The later Fri–Sat close has only one source.
note.zh: joe.coffee上（2026年10月）写的是每天早7点到半夜12点，周五周六开到凌晨1点；QNS（2025年4月）也说7点到半夜12点。周五周六开到1点只有一个来源。

note.en: Large, open shop with spacious seating and an outdoor patio; tables usually available.
note.zh: 店很大很开阔，还有户外座，一般都有位置。

note.en: Cozy off-peak, loud and hectic at peak times.
note.zh: 平时挺舒服，高峰期会很吵很乱。

note.en: Listing says the space suits calls as well as study.
note.zh: 有介绍说既能打电话也能安静学习。

busyTimes.en: Long waits at peak hours, especially weekends.
busyTimes.zh: 高峰期排队久，周末最明显。

blurb.en: Big, open coffee house on 31st St with a patio and plenty of tables. Calm enough for work or calls off-peak, but loud with long waits at busy times.
blurb.zh: 31st St上的Qahwah House，空间很大还有户外座，桌子多。非高峰期办公、打电话都可以，高峰期又吵又要排很久。

en: Long waits at peak times, especially weekends.
Wi-Fi and outlets not confirmed.
zh: 高峰期排队很久，周末尤其夸张。
Wi-Fi和插座都没查到确切信息。

note.en: The chain's site lists 7am–11pm; a Jul 2026 guide and a 2024 student review add a 1am close on Fri–Sat.
note.zh: 官网写的是早7点到晚11点；2026年7月的攻略和2024年的学生报道都说周五周六开到凌晨1点。

note.en: Free Wi-Fi is available; no speed reports found.
note.zh: 有免费 Wi-Fi，但没找到测速。

note.en: Outlets exist upstairs but are limited; come early at peak times.
note.zh: 楼上有插座但不多，高峰期要早点去。

note.en: Two floors of tables, though they fill at peak afternoon hours.
note.zh: 两层都是桌子，但下午高峰会坐满。

note.en: Upstairs is the quieter work floor; a 2024 review found loud music and bright lights late at night.
note.zh: 二楼比较适合干活；2024 年有测评说深夜音乐很大、灯很亮。

note.en: Shared coffee pots make it group-friendly, but big groups may wait for tables.
note.zh: 壶装咖啡适合几个人分着喝，但人多可能要等位。

busyTimes.en: Lunch is the peak; weekday 2–5pm is best for studying. Upstairs fills by ~9pm on weeknights; Fri–Sat late nights get social.
busyTimes.zh: 午饭时间最挤，工作日下午 2–5 点最适合学习。工作日晚上 9 点左右楼上基本满座，周五周六深夜比较热闹。

blurb.en: Yemeni coffeehouse by Columbia with two floors of tables and a bright upstairs lined with tall windows. Open till 11pm, 1am on weekends: a late-night study staple.
blurb.zh: 哥大旁边的也门咖啡馆，两层座位，二楼落地窗很亮。每天开到 11 点，周末到凌晨 1 点，深夜赶 due 的好去处。

en: Outlets are limited; grab an upstairs seat early.
Late nights can be loud, with music up and lights bright.
Fri–Sat nights turn social rather than studious.
zh: 插座不多，想要插座位就早点上二楼。
深夜音乐可能很大、灯也很亮。
周五周六晚上更像社交场，不太适合专心学习。

note.en: One undated visitor tip says there's no Wi-Fi (and laptops are fine on weekdays). Not confirmed elsewhere; bring a hotspot.
note.zh: 只有一条没日期的用户留言说没有Wi-Fi（工作日可以开电脑），没有别的来源证实，最好自带热点。

note.en: Half Half Travel (2026) says laptops are clearly welcome.
note.zh: Half Half Travel（2026）说这里很欢迎开电脑。

note.en: A Sept 2026 guide describes dialing into meetings here.
note.zh: 2026年9月的攻略提到可以在这儿开线上会。

blurb.en: Art-gallery-feeling cafe on Kent St, the original of a small local chain. A big wooden table anchors the room and laptops are welcome, but it closes at 4pm.
blurb.zh: Kent St 上像小画廊一样的咖啡馆，是这个本地小连锁的第一家。中间一张大木桌，欢迎开电脑，不过下午4点就关门。

en: Closes at 4pm every day.
Reportedly no Wi-Fi (one visitor tip); outlets unconfirmed.
zh: 每天下午4点就关门。
有人说没有Wi-Fi，插座也没确认，记得带热点。

note.en: Café hours. Bank appointment hours differ.
note.zh: 这是咖啡区的营业时间，银行办事时间不一样。

note.en: Free wifi is confirmed; we found no reports on its speed.
note.zh: 确认有免费wifi，但没找到网速的实测反馈。

note.en: Private meeting rooms and co-working spaces can be booked online at no charge.
note.zh: 私人会议室和办公位都可以在网上免费预约。

blurb.en: A bank branch built as a free co-working café: open to everyone, no account needed. Wifi, plenty of outlets, and free bookable meeting rooms near the Bedford L.
blurb.zh: 银行开的免费共享办公咖啡馆，不用开户谁都能来。有wifi、插座多，会议室还能免费预约。离Bedford L站很近。

en: Closes at 6pm (4pm on Sundays), early for a work spot.
The 30% drink discount is only for Santander card holders.
zh: 晚上6点就关（周日4点），下班后来不了。
饮品7折只限Santander卡用户。

note.en: Reported as reliable at about 120 Mbps.
note.zh: 有博主测过网速约120Mbps，挺稳。

note.en: 2024 review: more benches and bar seats than tables and outlets.
note.zh: 2024年的测评说长凳和吧台多，桌子和插座少。

note.en: Mostly benches and bars, few proper tables (2024 review).
note.zh: 以长凳和吧台为主，正经桌子不多（2024年信息）。

note.en: Famously hushed; staff encourage keeping it low-volume.
note.zh: 出了名的安静，店员会提醒大家小声。

note.en: Sources conflict: one 2026 guide says no formal laptop ban but short sessions are expected; another says laptops are banned on weekends. Look for signs.
note.zh: 说法不一：有2026年的攻略说没有明文禁电脑，但最好别久坐；也有说周末完全不让开电脑。进门先看有没有告示。

note.en: Hushed room where staff encourage low volume; not a place for calls.
note.zh: 店里很安静，店员鼓励小声，不适合打电话。

blurb.en: Light-filled Bushwick roastery known for light-roast pour-overs. Very quiet with solid Wi-Fi, but seating is mostly benches and bar, and laptops are tolerated rather than welcomed.
blurb.zh: Bushwick超出片的烘焙咖啡馆，浅烘手冲很有名。环境安静、网速不错，但座位多是长凳和吧台，电脑党只能算被容忍，别久坐。

en: Closes at 5pm every day.
Laptops may be banned on weekends; reports conflict, so check for signs.
Few tables and outlets; better for a short focused session than a full day.
zh: 每天下午5点就关门。
周末可能不让开电脑，说法不一，到店看告示。
桌子和插座都少，适合短时间专注，不适合泡一整天。

note.en: From a 2010 Time Out listing; not confirmed recently.
note.zh: 来自2010年的Time Out，最近没核实过，去之前确认一下。

note.en: OpenStreetMap: Wi-Fi available; speed not recorded
note.zh: OpenStreetMap：有 Wi-Fi，网速未记录

note.en: Time Out (2010) counted 60 outlets; BK Mag (Jan 2024) says plenty. Both are older sources.
note.zh: Time Out（2010）说有60个插座，BK Mag（2024年初）也说插座很多，但都是旧资料。

blurb.en: Cozy neighborhood cafe on Washington Ave, long known for its many outlets, with a backyard garden that shines in warm months.
blurb.zh: Washington Ave上的社区小咖啡馆，氛围很舒服，一直以插座多出名。天气好的时候后院花园特别出片。

en: Hours and most work details come from older sources; confirm it is open before you go.
zh: 营业时间和大部分信息都比较旧，出发前最好先确认还在营业。

note.en: OpenStreetMap: community-mapped opening hours (checked 2026-05-31)
note.zh: OpenStreetMap：社区维护的营业时间（2026-05-31 核对）

note.en: Free 'NYPL' Wi-Fi with no password or card at every NYPL branch during open hours (June 2026 guide); speed at this branch not reported.
note.zh: NYPL所有分馆开放时间都有免费Wi-Fi（网络名NYPL，不用密码也不用借书证，2026年6月的攻略）；这家分馆网速没人测过。

note.en: About 1,500 seats across seven floors.
note.zh: 七层楼一共约1500个座位。

blurb.en: NYPL's big circulating library across from Bryant Park: about 1,500 seats over seven floors, group study rooms, a business center and a rooftop terrace.
blurb.zh: Bryant Park对面的纽约公共图书馆总借阅馆，七层楼约1500个座位，有小组学习室、商务中心，还有屋顶露台。

en: Group study rooms exist on each floor, but we couldn't confirm how booking works.
Hours and Wi-Fi unverified; NYPL's site blocked our check.
zh: 每层都有小组学习室，但预约方式没能确认。
营业时间和网速都没核实，NYPL官网查不到。

note.en: Aug 2024 review: works well, no complaints.
note.zh: 2024年8月的测评：网能用，没毛病。

note.en: Aug 2024 review.
note.zh: 2024年8月的测评。

note.en: Aug 2024: five 2-tops, four counter seats, couches, an 8-seat communal table, plus a backyard on nice days.
note.zh: 2024年8月：5张双人桌、4个吧台位、几张沙发、一张8人长桌，天气好还有后院。

note.en: Fairly quiet for touristy SoHo (Aug 2024).
note.zh: 以SoHo的人流来说算安静（2024年8月）。

note.en: 8-seat communal table (Aug 2024).
note.zh: 有一张能坐8人的长桌（2024年8月）。

note.en: One single-stall restroom in the back.
note.zh: 后面有一个单人洗手间。

blurb.en: SoHo cafe with an 8-seat communal table, couches, plugs all over and a backyard with more big-table seating on nice days. One of the better group spots in the area.
blurb.zh: SoHo的咖啡店，有一张8人长桌、沙发，到处都有插座，天气好时后院还有大桌。在这一带算很适合小组一起办公的。

en: Only one restroom.
All work details are from an Aug 2024 review; hours not confirmed.
zh: 只有一个洗手间。
办公信息来自2024年8月的测评，营业时间没确认。

note.en: OpenStreetMap: community-mapped opening hours (checked 2026-06-01)
note.zh: OpenStreetMap：社区维护的营业时间（2026-06-01 核对）

note.en: Half Half Travel measured about 170 Mbps down / 60 up (2026).
note.zh: Half Half Travel 实测下载约170M、上传60M（2026）。

note.en: Outlets are scarce; come charged.
note.zh: 插座很少，最好充满电再来。

note.en: About 25 seats, including a back-room table for 14.
note.zh: 大概25个座位，后面房间有张能坐14人的长桌。

note.en: Listed as a work spot with laptop users; no written laptop policy found, including for weekends.
note.zh: 被多个办公指南推荐，常见有人开电脑；但没找到明文规定（包括周末）。

note.en: The long back-room table seats 14.
note.zh: 后屋长桌能坐14人。

blurb.en: Plant shop meets cafe in Bed-Stuy, with a back room built around a 14-seat communal table and genuinely fast Wi-Fi. Good for a small crew working side by side.
blurb.zh: Bed-Stuy 的植物店+咖啡馆，后屋一张能坐14人的大长桌，网速很快。几个朋友一起来办公很合适。

en: Few outlets, so arrive charged.
Also a brunch spot, so expect food traffic.
zh: 插座很少，记得先充好电。
也是早午餐店，饭点人会多一些。

note.en: BPL offers free Wi-Fi but its own terms say it can't guarantee a connection; speed here is unmeasured.
note.zh: 布鲁克林图书馆有免费Wi-Fi，但官方说不保证连接，这家网速没人测过。

note.en: Meeting rooms can be requested through BPL's room reservation site (library card needed); there's also a recording studio for cardholders.
note.zh: 会议室可以在BPL官网预约（要借书证）；持卡还能用录音室。

blurb.en: Bright, two-floor Brooklyn library branch that opened in late 2023, about twice the size of the old one, with bookable meeting rooms and a recording studio.
blurb.zh: 2023年底新开的布鲁克林图书馆分馆，两层多、很亮堂，面积是老馆两倍。能预约会议室，还有录音室。

en: Closed Sundays.
Opens at 1pm on Tuesdays.
zh: 周日闭馆。
周二下午1点才开门。

note.en: Described as reliable.
note.zh: 网络被评价为稳定靠谱。

note.en: Calm and productive, not library-silent.
note.zh: 整体很安静、有工作氛围，但不是图书馆那种鸦雀无声。

note.en: Featured as a work-from-cafe spot; regulars are freelancers.
note.zh: 被列为适合办公的咖啡店，常客多是自由职业者。

blurb.en: Long-running Greenpoint roaster with generous seating, reliable Wi-Fi and a calm room full of freelancers. Open till 7pm daily.
blurb.zh: Greenpoint的老牌烘焙咖啡店，座位多，网络稳定，常客都是自由职业者，环境安静有工作氛围。每天开到晚上7点。

en: The official site lists 159 Freeman St; one 2026 guide gives 135 Kent St instead. Trust the official address.
Outlet situation unknown; bring a charged laptop.
zh: 官网地址是159 Freeman St，有篇2026年的攻略写成了135 Kent St，以官网为准。
插座多少不清楚，电脑最好先充满。

name: Sweetleaf
address: 10-93 Jackson Ave, Long Island City, NY 11101

note.en: Listing (updated Oct 2026) says free Wi-Fi at Sweetleaf Coffee Roasters but gives no address; speed not reported.
note.zh: 榜单（2026年10月更新）说Sweetleaf Coffee Roasters有免费Wi-Fi，但没写是哪家店，网速也没提。

note.en: Undated listing; not explicitly tied to the Jackson Ave branch.
note.zh: 来源没日期，也没明确说是Jackson Ave这家。

note.en: A listing says no screens on weekends; a 2026 guide calls the Jackson Ave cafe work-friendly. Weekend rule not confirmed by the venue.
note.zh: 有榜单说周末不让用电脑；2026年的攻略说Jackson Ave这家适合办公。周末规定店家官方没确认。

note.en: Listing mentions a customer bathroom; not explicitly tied to the Jackson Ave address.
note.zh: 榜单说有给顾客用的洗手间，但没明确是Jackson Ave这家。

blurb.en: Sweetleaf's Jackson Ave cafe in LIC. Reviews describe a living-room feel and a quieter laptop room in back. Weekend screen rules are reported, so come on weekdays.
blurb.zh: Sweetleaf在LIC Jackson Ave的店，据说像客厅一样舒服，后面有个更安静的电脑区。听说周末不让开电脑，建议工作日来。

en: Reportedly no laptops/screens on weekends.
Closes at 7pm.
zh: 据说周末不让开电脑。
晚上7点关门。

note.en: OpenStreetMap: community-mapped opening hours
note.zh: OpenStreetMap：社区维护的营业时间

note.en: Free wifi reported, but no speed info; one listing says sessions last 2 hours and renew with a purchase.
note.zh: 有免费Wi-Fi，但没人说网速；有资料说每次限2小时，再消费可以续。

note.en: Half Half confirms outlets here; 'plenty' comes from chain-wide or undated sources.
note.zh: Half Half确认这家有插座；“插座很多”来自整个连锁或没日期的资料。

note.en: Lots of seats, but small round tables are packed close together.
note.zh: 座位不少，但小圆桌挨得很近，基本是肩并肩。

note.en: No posted seat limit; wifi reportedly times out after 2 hours (renew with a purchase), and staff may comment if you stay several hours without ordering.
note.zh: 没有明确的座位限时；Wi-Fi据说2小时一断（再买东西可续），坐太久不点单店员可能会提醒。

note.en: One undated listing says you need a purchase to get the bathroom key.
note.zh: 有一条没日期的资料说要先消费才给厕所钥匙。

blurb.en: Classic East Village laptop cafe, now the Bean's last neighborhood location. Outlets and plenty of seats, but tables sit tight and it gets busy.
blurb.zh: 东村老牌电脑咖啡馆，现在是The Bean在东村仅剩的一家。插座和座位都不少，就是桌子挨得紧，人也多。

en: Wifi reportedly cuts off after 2 hours; buy something to renew.
Small tables packed close, so expect elbow-to-elbow neighbors.
Staff may nudge long stays if you stop ordering.
zh: Wi-Fi据说2小时就断，再买点东西才能续。
小桌子挨得很近，基本和旁边人贴着坐。
坐很久不点单，店员可能会委婉提醒。

note.en: Hours of The Bar Room, the hotel's lobby bar and restaurant, from the hotel's site.
note.zh: 这是酒店大堂餐吧The Bar Room的营业时间，来自官网。

note.en: Armchairs are easy to get during the day; it fills up at night (Sep 2026).
note.zh: 白天很容易抢到扶手椅，晚上会坐满（2026年9月）。

note.en: An Oct 2026 guide calls it quiet; a 2024 piece described a busier buzz of remote workers.
note.zh: 2026年10月的文章说很安静；2024年的文章说远程办公的人多、挺热闹。

note.en: A 2026 guide says you don't need to be a hotel guest to work in the lobby; no posted policy.
note.zh: 2026年的文章说不住店也能在大堂办公，酒店没公开具体规定。

busyTimes.en: Easy to find a seat in the daytime; the after-work crowd arrives around 4pm and it's packed at night.
busyTimes.zh: 白天座位好找，下午4点左右下班人群涌进来，晚上很满。

blurb.en: Landmark FiDi hotel with a nine-story atrium. Non-guests reportedly work in the lobby, with solid Wi-Fi and a calm feel.
blurb.zh: FiDi的地标酒店，九层挑高的中庭超震撼。据说不住店也能在大堂办公，网速稳，整体很安静。

en: The atrium is a photo hotspot, so expect people popping in for pictures.
Hotel policies can change; buy a drink and be discreet.
Plan to wrap up by ~4pm, when the after-work bar crowd arrives.
zh: 中庭是网红打卡点，会有人进来拍照。
酒店政策随时可能变，最好点杯喝的、低调一点。
最好4点前收工，之后下班喝酒的人就多了。

note.en: Kitchen closes at 2pm daily.
note.zh: 厨房每天下午2点就停止出餐。

note.en: Described as pretty reliable.
note.zh: 网络还算稳定。

note.en: Outlets both inside and in the garden.
note.zh: 室内和后院都有插座。

note.en: Most of the room is the leafy back garden, so seating depends on weather.
note.zh: 座位多主要靠后花园，天气不好时就没那么宽敞了。

note.en: Guide (Jun 2025) calls the back garden perfect for freelancers on laptops.
note.zh: 2025年6月的攻略说后花园很适合抱电脑的自由职业者。

blurb.en: Cozy Hamilton Heights cafe whose real draw is a leafy back garden with lots of seating and outlets. Wi-Fi is solid enough for a few hours of work.
blurb.zh: Hamilton Heights的温馨小咖啡馆，最大亮点是绿植满满的后花园，座位多，还有插座。网络够稳，坐几个小时办公没问题。

en: Closes at 5pm every day; kitchen stops at 2pm.
Much of the seating is outdoors in the garden.
zh: 每天下午5点就关门，厨房2点停止出餐。
很多座位在户外花园，看天气。

note.en: Free, reliable; one speed test logged ~245 Mbps down.
note.zh: 免费Wi-Fi，很稳，有人测过下载约245Mbps。

note.en: Outlets listed as limited.
note.zh: 插座有限。

note.en: Spacious, with window seats up front and large communal tables in back.
note.zh: 空间大，前面有靠窗位，后面有大长桌。

note.en: Moderate-to-low noise; busier at peak times.
note.zh: 整体偏安静，高峰期会吵一点。

note.en: Listed as a focused-work spot; no explicit policy found.
note.zh: 被列为适合专注工作的地方，没找到明确规定。

note.en: Large communal tables in back suggest small groups can sit together.
note.zh: 后面有大长桌，几个人一起坐应该没问题。

blurb.en: Spacious Grand St cafe with fast, reliable Wi-Fi, window seats up front and big communal tables in back. Quiet enough to write; outlets are scarce, so charge up first.
blurb.zh: Grand St上很宽敞的咖啡馆，网速快又稳，前面靠窗、后面大长桌。安静适合写东西，就是插座少，出门前充满电。

en: Outlets are limited.
Gets busier at peak times; go off-peak for quiet.
zh: 插座不多。
高峰期人多，想安静就错峰去。

note.en: These are the K'Far Lobby Bar hours on the Hoxton's site (Sun–Wed 8am–11:30pm, Thu–Sat to 12:30am). The K'Far Cafe coffee counter is only open 8am–3pm.
note.zh: 这是Hoxton官网上K'Far大堂吧的营业时间（周日到周三早8点到晚11点半，周四到周六开到凌晨12点半）。K'Far咖啡柜台只开早8点到下午3点。

note.en: Hotel says fast, free Wi-Fi throughout; not independently tested.
note.zh: 酒店官网说全馆免费高速Wi-Fi，没有第三方实测。

note.en: Expansive lobby with sofas and armchairs (2024 sources).
note.zh: 大堂很大，沙发扶手椅很多（2024年的信息）。

note.en: 2024 sources say it's popular with remote workers and staff don't rush you out.
note.zh: 2024年的文章说很多远程办公的人来，店员不会赶人。

blurb.en: Living-room style hotel lobby with vintage sofas, armchairs and two fireplaces, plus K'Far for coffee and food. Long a remote-worker favorite.
blurb.zh: 客厅风的酒店大堂，复古沙发、扶手椅，还有两个壁炉，大堂里的K'Far可以买咖啡吃饭。一直很受远程办公党欢迎。

en: Free live jazz in the lobby Saturdays 7–10pm, so evenings get loud.
No source says whether a purchase is expected; buying something at K'Far is the safe move.
The coffee counter (K'Far Cafe) closes at 3pm; after that it's the lobby bar.
zh: 每周六晚7-10点大堂有爵士现场，晚上会比较吵。
没查到是否要求消费，保险起见在K'Far点一杯。
咖啡柜台（K'Far Cafe）下午3点就关了，之后只有大堂吧。

note.en: OpenStreetMap: community-mapped opening hours
note.zh: OpenStreetMap：社区维护的营业时间

note.en: Outlets under the seats along the wall; none at the bar (2024 review).
note.zh: 插座在靠墙座位下面，吧台那边没有（2024年测评）。

note.en: A 2024 review reported a 2-hour Wi-Fi limit; enforcement unclear.
note.zh: 2024年的测评说 Wi-Fi 限时2小时，执行得严不严不确定。

note.en: Bustling room; expect background noise on calls.
note.zh: 店里比较热闹，打电话会有背景音。

note.en: Several four-top tables (2024 review).
note.zh: 有好几张四人桌（2024年测评）。

note.en: The 'Read Room' can be booked via the venue site; capacity and price not listed.
note.zh: 官网可以预约 Read Room，但没写能坐几个人和价格。

blurb.en: Screenwriter-themed cafe with big tables, Wi-Fi and wall outlets, plus a bookable 'Read Room'. Bustling but workable; open late most days.
blurb.zh: 编剧主题咖啡馆，大桌子、有 Wi-Fi、靠墙有插座，还能预约 Read Room。人有点多但能干活，大部分日子开得挺晚。

en: Possible 2-hour Wi-Fi limit (reported 2024).
Too busy for clean calls.
No outlets at the bar seats.
zh: 可能有 Wi-Fi 两小时限制（2024年有人提过）。
人多，打电话会很吵。
吧台座位没有插座。

note.en: Sources conflict: a recent guide calls the Wi-Fi reliable, but Half Half (Sep 2026) says Think locations have no Wi-Fi, and older reviews call it flaky.
note.zh: 说法打架：有指南说网络稳定，但Half Half（2026年9月）说Think各家店都没Wi-Fi，较早的评价也说会掉线。

note.en: One recent guide says plenty of outlets; older user reviews complain there are not enough.
note.zh: 有指南说插座很多，但也有较早的评价吐槽插座不够。

note.en: Roughly 50 to 75 seats.
note.zh: 大概50到75个座位。

note.en: Steady student buzz.
note.zh: 一直有学生聊天的白噪音。

blurb.en: Think's flagship on NYU's campus: big, open late-ish, and full of laptops and study groups. Lots of seats, but fills up with students.
blurb.zh: Think Coffee 在 NYU 校园里的旗舰店，空间大、开到晚上7点，到处是开电脑和小组学习的学生。座位多，但很容易被学生坐满。

en: Packed with NYU students; tables can be hard to get.
Reports on outlets and Wi-Fi conflict, so bring a charged laptop.
zh: NYU 学生超多，经常找不到位子。
插座和网速评价不一，最好带满电的电脑。

note.en: WFHishNYC (Jan 2026) found password-protected wifi that works fine here; Half Half (Sep 2026) says Think locations have no wifi. Bring a hotspot just in case.
note.zh: WFHishNYC（2026年1月）说这家有密码Wi-Fi，够用；Half Half（2026年9月）却说Think连锁都没Wi-Fi。保险起见带个热点。

note.en: Background music and chatter, but high ceilings keep it from getting loud.
note.zh: 有背景音乐和聊天声，但层高很高，不会太吵。

note.en: Think's own site calls this location well-suited for focused work.
note.zh: Think官网自己都说这家店适合专心干活。

note.en: The Infatuation (2023) says staff don't care how long you stay with a laptop; not reconfirmed.
note.zh: The Infatuation（2023）说店员不在意你开电脑坐多久，近期没再确认。

note.en: Long communal table up front seats about 15.
note.zh: 门口有一张能坐约15人的长桌。

note.en: One single-person bathroom (Jan 2026).
note.zh: 只有一个单人洗手间（2026年1月）。

blurb.en: Big, bright Think Coffee on Broadway with a 15-seat communal table, booths along the walls and outlets by many tables. Calls are fine if you keep it low.
blurb.zh: Broadway上的大店，采光好，门口一张能坐15人的长桌，靠墙还有卡座，很多桌边都有插座。小声打电话没问题。

en: Wifi reports conflict; bring a hotspot as backup.
Just one single-person bathroom.
Closes at 6pm every day; weekends open at 8am.
zh: Wi-Fi说法不一，最好带热点备用。
只有一个单人厕所。
每天下午6点关门，周末早上8点才开。

name: Urban Garden Room at One Bryant Park
address: 1 Bryant Park (Sixth Ave at W 43rd St), New York, NY 10036

note.en: Tables go fast to Midtown office workers around midday.
note.zh: 中午附近上班族一来，桌子很快就被占满。

blurb.en: Indoor public space with big windows at the foot of One Bryant Park, with big sculptural plantings. It works as a free, heated extension of Bryant Park.
blurb.zh: One Bryant Park楼下的室内公共空间，落地大窗，有大型绿植雕塑，相当于Bryant Park的室内延伸，免费还有暖气。

en: Tables fill up with office workers at lunch.
No food sold inside per a 2025 guide; Whole Foods is across the street.
Used for evening performances (8–11pm), when the public has to stay outside.
zh: 午饭时间桌子会被上班族占满。
2025年的攻略说里面不卖吃的，对面就是Whole Foods。
晚上8–11点有演出排练，这时公众不能进。

note.en: OpenStreetMap: community-mapped opening hours
note.zh: OpenStreetMap：社区维护的营业时间

note.en: Free Wi-Fi confirmed; speed not rated.
note.zh: 有免费Wi-Fi，网速没人具体说。

note.en: Small round quartz tables; seats go fast.
note.zh: 都是小圆桌，座位抢手。

note.en: Guides list a public restroom.
note.zh: 攻略里说有对外开放的洗手间。

busyTimes.en: Busy all day with no real lull; come early for a seat.
busyTimes.zh: 全天都很忙，基本没有空档，想要座位就早点去。

blurb.en: Always-buzzing Chelsea outpost of the Brooklyn roaster. Free Wi-Fi, some outlets and a restroom, but small quartz tables and a steady line make it better for a few hours than a full day.
blurb.zh: Brooklyn烘焙品牌在Chelsea的店，一直很热闹。有免费Wi-Fi、插座和洗手间，不过桌子小、人多，适合待几个小时，不太适合坐一整天。

en: Tiny tables and so-so chairs; not great for a long day.
Hours not confirmed from the venue.
zh: 桌子很小，椅子也不太舒服，久坐会累。
官方营业时间没查到。

note.en: No hours on Variety's site.
note.zh: 官网没写营业时间。

note.en: Half Half Travel calls this the smaller Variety, with extra outdoor seating in a street corral.
note.zh: Half Half Travel 说这家是 Variety 里比较小的一家，门口路边有围起来的户外座。

busyTimes.en: Fills up around 11am; thins out again around 2pm.
busyTimes.zh: 11点左右就坐满，下午2点后人会少一些。

blurb.en: Small Variety outpost on Driggs with strong Wi-Fi, lots of plugs and tables big enough for a laptop plus notebook. Get there before 11.
blurb.zh: Driggs 街上的 Variety 小店，网速快、插座多，桌子够放电脑加本子。最好11点前到。

en: Small room that fills by ~11am; come early or after 2pm.
A newer Variety (Greenpoint Landing, 190 Franklin St) is separate from this one.
zh: 店不大，11点左右就满，早点来或者下午2点后再来。
Variety 在 Greenpoint Landing（190 Franklin St）还有一家新店，别走错。

note.en: OpenStreetMap: community-mapped opening hours
note.zh: OpenStreetMap：社区维护的营业时间

note.en: Listed in a Sept 2026 guide to cafes for getting work done; no written policy found.
note.zh: 上了2026年9月的办公咖啡店榜单，没找到明文的电脑规定。

blurb.en: Big, sunny Park Slope branch of the local Variety chain with fast Wi-Fi and lots of seats. Prospect Park is a short walk away for a reset.
blurb.zh: 本地连锁Variety在Park Slope的店，空间大、阳光好，网速快座位多。累了走几步就到Prospect Park透透气。

en: Hours weren't posted on the chain's site; check before you go.
zh: 官网没写营业时间，去之前先查一下。

note.en: OpenStreetMap: community-mapped opening hours
note.zh: OpenStreetMap：社区维护的营业时间

note.en: Consistently described as reliable; no speed tests found.
note.zh: 多个来源都说网络稳定，但没有测速数据。

note.en: About 13 small two-person tables (2024); often full.
note.zh: 大约 13 张小两人桌（2024 年），经常坐满。

note.en: Tables are small two-tops.
note.zh: 都是小两人桌。

blurb.en: One of the few UES cafés with real indoor seating: big windows, outlets at most tables and steady Wi-Fi. Small two-tops and it's often full.
blurb.zh: 上东区少有能坐下来干活的咖啡馆，大窗户采光好，大部分桌子都有插座，网络稳。就是桌子小，经常满座。

en: Often full; tables are small two-tops, so not for groups.
Hours not confirmed; check before going.
zh: 经常满座，桌子都是小两人桌，不适合多人。
营业时间没查到，去之前先确认。

note.en: From joe.coffee's listing (7am–6pm, closed Tuesday). An older directory shows Tuesday open, so the Tuesday closure is unconfirmed; no venue site found.
note.zh: 来自joe.coffee页面（早7到晚6，周二休息）。有个旧目录写周二也开，所以周二到底开不开还没定论，店家也没官网。

note.en: Two guides confirm Wi-Fi, one calls it reliable; no speed data.
note.zh: 两篇攻略都说有Wi-Fi，其中一篇说挺稳，没有测速。

note.en: Plenty of space on weekdays, but can get busy enough that people take orders to go.
note.zh: 工作日空位多，但人多时可能只能外带。

note.en: No limit found; a customer review on the cafe's listing wishes there were one.
note.zh: 没查到限时规定，有顾客评论还说希望店里设个时间限制。

busyTimes.en: Best on weekdays; can get busy enough that you'll take your drink to go.
busyTimes.zh: 工作日去最好，人多的时候可能只能外带。

blurb.en: Low-key Astoria cafe with warm brown walls, plants and reliable Wi-Fi. Known for its iced matcha einspänner and egg sando; weekdays are the time to settle in.
blurb.zh: Astoria的低调小店，棕色墙配绿植，网很稳。招牌是冰抹茶einspänner和鸡蛋三明治，工作日来最舒服。

en: Can get crowded; Saturdays often mean a wait, and weekends are a gamble for seats.
Hours unconfirmed: a third-party listing says 7am–6pm and closed Tuesdays, but an older one shows Tuesday open.
zh: 人多时很挤，周六经常要排队，周末不一定有位子。
营业时间没官方确认：第三方页面写早7到晚6、周二休息，但旧一点的页面写周二照常开。

note.en: An older, undated Tribeca Citizen listing says the upstairs seating has free Wi-Fi. Not reconfirmed recently; speed unknown.
note.zh: Tribeca Citizen一篇较早的介绍（没标日期）说楼上座位区有免费Wi-Fi，最近没再确认，网速未知。

note.en: Dec 2024 local post: some outlets for charging.
note.zh: 2024年12月的本地帖子：有一些插座可以充电。

note.en: Upstairs cafe seating; only a few quieter seats by the north windows.
note.zh: 楼上有用餐区，只有北侧靠窗几张位子相对清静。

note.en: Dec 2024: crying babies, phones on speaker, loud calls.
note.zh: 2024年12月：有小孩哭、有人外放、有人大声打电话。

note.en: The store page lists an in-store Meeting Space for meetings and events; booking terms and cost aren't posted.
note.zh: 官网写店里有可以办会议和活动的Meeting Space，但没写怎么订、要不要钱。

blurb.en: Upstairs cafe seating at the Greenwich St Whole Foods, open 7am–10pm daily. Some outlets and snacks on hand, but it's a grocery store: noisy, with few tucked-away seats.
blurb.zh: Whole Foods楼上的用餐区，每天早7点到晚10点。有些插座、吃东西方便，但毕竟是超市，很吵，安静的位置不多。

en: Can be very loud: kids, speakerphone calls.
Only a few semi-private seats by the north windows.
Buy something; it's store seating.
zh: 可能很吵，小孩、外放电话都有。
只有北边窗户那几张位置相对隐蔽。
毕竟是店里的座位，买点东西再坐。

name: Whole Foods Market Union Square
address: 4 Union Sq S, New York, NY 10003

note.en: These are store hours; the seating area's hours may differ.
note.zh: 这是超市营业时间，用餐区不一定一样。

note.en: The store lists cafe seating but gives no size or location.
note.zh: 官网写了有用餐座位，但没说多大、在哪层。

blurb.en: Union Square supermarket with in-store cafe seating and a coffee bar, open 7am to 10pm daily. Handy for a quick session between errands.
blurb.zh: Union Square的Whole Foods，店里有用餐座位和咖啡吧，每天早7点到晚10点。办事间隙临时干点活挺方便。

en: Seating is meant for customers; buy something first.
zh: 座位是给顾客用的，先买点东西再坐。

note.en: Free BPLUNWIRED Wi-Fi at every branch per BPL; speed not documented.
note.zh: BPL所有分馆都有免费Wi-Fi（BPLUNWIRED），官方没写网速。

note.en: BPL offers free Wi-Fi for laptop users at every branch.
note.zh: BPL所有分馆都给带电脑的读者提供免费Wi-Fi。

note.en: Meeting rooms are reserved through BPL's room booking system with a library card.
note.zh: 会议室可以用BPL借书卡在官网预约。

blurb.en: Historic BPL branch at Division and Marcy, fully accessible, with meeting rooms you can reserve online. Open late Tuesday and Thursday.
blurb.zh: Division和Marcy路口的老牌BPL分馆，无障碍设施齐全，会议室能在网上预约。周二周四开到晚上8点。

en: Closed Sundays.
Tuesday opens at 1pm, not 10am.
Saturday closes at 5pm.
zh: 周日不开。
周二下午1点才开门。
周六下午5点就关。

note.en: Brookfield Place FAQ says the Winter Garden is open 24/7; shops and food halls keep shorter hours.
note.zh: 官方FAQ说Winter Garden全天24小时开放，但商店和美食广场营业时间短得多。

note.en: Free Wi-Fi with a splash-page login; speed not verified.
note.zh: 有免费Wi-Fi，要在登录页连接，网速未实测。

blurb.en: Palm-filled glass atrium on the Hudson with free Wi-Fi and open space for coffee or a call. Food halls next door make it an easy free meetup spot downtown.
blurb.zh: 哈德逊河边的玻璃中庭，种满棕榈树。有免费Wi-Fi，空间开阔，喝咖啡、打电话都行。旁边就是美食广场，下城免费碰头的好地方。

en: Hosts concerts and events that can take over the space
Outlet and table availability not confirmed
zh: 经常办音乐会和活动，会占掉场地
有没有插座和桌子还没确认
